We release \bench, ten real relationships with an AI companion: 27,218 messages over up to 120 days, released as the conversation and four files derived from it, a profile, a persona, a chat ground truth and a question set, each citing the messages it rests on. Every chat label carries the reasoning trace that produced it, checked stage by stage against the conversation. Three findings follow. First, the past is rarely needed and far away. Pooled measures mislead: a recency window finds the required message for 95.9\% of probes and 2.2\% of those that need memory, and at the natural rate 96\% of the gain from supplying recorded evidence comes from messages that need none. Second, no detector we tried can tell when memory is needed on real messages, authored questions over the same histories leak the cue, and labeling the same messages as memories raises their use by ten to fourteen points. Third, three agent systems reconstruct the persona with the same F1 at a 31-fold difference in cost.

</details>


### [411] [Q-Learning for Reachability in MEC-Free MDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01781)
*Lu-Chin Chang,Suguman Bansal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Quasar，首个针对无非终端最大环分量（MEC）MDP片段具有渐近保证的模型自由可达性强化学习算法。它通过时序差分更新收敛至最优策略，无需估计转移概率，显著降低内存占用并减少样本需求，优于现有基于模型的SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的可达性规范强化学习工作虽已建立渐近收敛性，但仅限于需要显式估计马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）转移概率的基于模型的方法。这导致较高的计算复杂度和内存开销，限制了其在大规模问题中的实际应用。

Method: 提出Quasar算法，这是一种模型自由的Q-learning变体。它利用时序差分更新直接收敛到最优策略，避免了学习转移概率。该方法适用于标准MEC商分解后不含非终端最大环分量（MECs）的MDP片段，这是通过标准MEC商约简得到的通用MDP结构的一部分。

Result: 1. 理论保证：在指定的MDP片段上实现了渐近收敛至最优策略。
2. 效率提升：内存足迹从基于模型方法的O(|S|^2|A|)降低至O(|S||A|)。
3. 性能优势：在标准化定量验证基准集（QVBS）上，相比之前的基于模型的最先进方法，收敛所需样本量减少了多个数量级。

Conclusion: Quasar证明了模型自由方法在特定MDP结构下实现高效、低资源消耗的可达性学习是可行的。这一成果为可达性学习和规范引导强化学习（specification-guided RL）的实际部署迈出了具体且重要的一步。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for reachability specifications is fundamental to sequential decision-making. Prior work establishes asymptotic convergence to optimal policies, but only through model-based methods that must explicitly estimate the transition probabilities of the underlying Markov Decision Process (MDP). We present Quasar, the first model-free algorithm with asymptotic guarantees for reachability on the fragment of MDPs free of non-terminal maximal end components (MECs), a building block to which every MDP reduces by the standard MEC quotient. Our algorithm follows the classical Q-learning approach, using temporal-difference updates to converge to an optimal policy without ever learning the transition probabilities. The resulting learner reduces the memory footprint from the O(|S|^2|A|) that model-based methods require to O(|S||A|). On the standardized Quantitative Verification Benchmark Set, our algorithm converges to the optimal policy with orders of magnitude fewer samples than the previous model-based state-of-the-art. Together these results are a concrete step toward the practical deployment of reachability learning and, with it, of specification-guided RL.

</details>


### [412] [Not All Experience Belongs in the Weights: Component Routing for Self-Improving GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01787)
*Beining Wu,Zihao Ding,Jun Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出“组件路由”机制，将GUI代理经验分解为定位器、程序、状态事实和教训四个组件，并根据其特性（重复性和状态条件性）自动分配至权重微调或上下文检索，显著优于单一目的地和整体轨迹基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决现有GUI自改进研究中关于将经验用于微调还是提示检索存在分歧的问题。原因在于轨迹作为经验单元捆绑了不同性质的项目，导致结论依赖于混合比例，缺乏细粒度的优化策略。

Method: 1. 引入组件路由：将轨迹拆分为定位器、程序、状态事实和教训，分别送入上下文或权重进行对比实验。
2. 拟合规则：基于训练前的两个属性（重复性 recurrence 和状态条件性 state-conditionality）预测最佳目的地。
3. 分析差异：研究训练过程及生产者-消费者差异对两种目的地价值的影响。

Result: 1. 定位器和教训在权重中表现更好，程序和状态事实在上下文中表现更好。
2. 拟合的规则在24/24个测试单元格中准确恢复了保留主干网络的目的地。
3. 基于规则的组件路由优于所有整体轨迹基线，并比各主干网络的最佳单一目的地平均高出3.5分。
4. 发现读取性能随组件写入权重而下降（高频项最明显），上下文收益与信息缺口正相关，权重收益与策略缺口负相关。

Conclusion: 细粒度的组件路由机制能更有效地利用GUI代理的经验，通过区分不同组件的特性来优化其存储和检索方式，从而提升代理性能。

Abstract: Self-improving GUI agents keep the trajectories they produce and return them to the agent, by fine-tuning or by retrieval into the prompt, and studies that compare the two destinations disagree. We attribute this to the unit of experience: a trajectory bundles items with different properties, so a conclusion about the bundle depends on its mix. To address this, (i) we introduce component routing, which splits the experience into locators, procedures, state facts and lessons and sends each component to the context or to the weights, compared on the same items across three backbone families, two environments and three seeds. One pool has two destinations: locators and lessons win in the weights, procedures and state facts in the context. (ii) We fit a rule in two properties measured before any training, recurrence and state-conditionality; it recovers the destination of a held-out backbone family in 24 of 24 cells, two interventions move a component toward the boundary, and routing by the rule beats every whole-trajectory baseline and, by +3.5 points on average, the better single destination of each backbone. (iii) We identify how training and producer-consumer differences change the value of the two destinations: note readout decreases after the same component is written into the weights, most for the items that recur most, context gains increase with the information gap, and weights gains decrease with the policy gap. Code and data will be released.

</details>


### [413] [LineupRL: Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Time Series Captioning via Caption-to-Series Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01800)
*Haochen Zhang,Laura Yao,Zachary Plotkin,Gengwei Zhang,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LineupRL，一种基于可验证奖励的强化学习管道，通过冻结LLM作为验证器进行“标题-序列”识别来优化时间序列描述生成，在多项指标上超越SFT和传统RL基线，且小模型性能优于大模型蒸馏结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有监督微调（SFT）受限于更大模型的 caption 质量上限；而传统强化学习（RL）的奖励机制针对其他模态或任务设计，难以有效迁移到时间序列领域的开放式生成任务中。

Method: 提出 LineupRL 管道，采用“caption-to-series identification”作为奖励信号。使用冻结的大语言模型（LLM）作为验证器，直接读取生成的 caption 和候选时间序列的原始数值（而非图表），从多个干扰项中选出被描述的序列。该匹配任务对验证器要求较低，无需其具备写作或复杂评判能力。

Result: 在两个 captioning 基准测试以及预测和重建任务中，LineupRL 在所有指标上均优于 SFT 和 RL 基线。训练出的 3B 参数视觉语言模型（VLM）以 1/24 的参数量，超越了由 SFT 基线所蒸馏自的 72B VLM。案例研究表明该方法能抵抗奖励黑客攻击，且生成的 caption 能准确追踪趋势并标注关键点数值。

Conclusion: LineupRL 通过引入基于可验证奖励的强化学习机制，解决了时间序列 captioning 中奖励信号适配性差的问题，显著提升了生成质量和效率，证明了轻量级模型结合特定奖励设计可超越大规模蒸馏模型。

Abstract: Time series captioning is a fundamental step in time series understanding and can also serve as the bridge between signal and natural language. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) relies on a larger model's captions and cannot exceed their quality. Reinforcement learning (RL) can, but its rewards were designed for other modalities and other tasks, and they transfer poorly to open-ended generation in the time series domain. We address this by proposing LineupRL, a reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) pipeline whose reward is caption-to-series identification. The reward model is a frozen large language model (LLM) verifier that reads the generated caption and the candidate time series as raw values, never the chart, and must pick the described time series from multiple distractors. Matching is a far lighter demand on the verifier than writing questions or judging a caption, so an off-the-shelf LLM can supply the reward. Across two captioning benchmarks, and on forecasting and reconstruction where the predictor sees only the caption, LineupRL outperforms SFT and RL baselines on every metric. The 3B vision language model (VLM) trained by LineupRL also outperforms, at 1/24 of the parameters, the 72B VLM whose captions the SFT baseline is distilled from. Our case study shows that LineupRL resists reward hacking, and that the captioner it trains both traces the trend and names the values at key points.

</details>


### [414] [AI-assisted mitotic counting improves reproducibility and efficiency across multiple tumour types](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01813)
*Simon Graham,Mostafa Jahanifar,Quoc Dang Vu,Vygante Maskoliunaite,Donatas Petroska,Ruta Barbora Valkiuniene,Ayat Gamal Lashen,Jen Hong Ong,Amede Ogechi Nnorom,Sinclair Couper,Natasha Kardasz,Reshma Agrawal,Brinder Singh Chohan,Jose Luis Solorzano Rendon,Shonali Natu,Arvydas Laurinavicius,Nasir Rajpoot,David Snead*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MitPro是一款AI辅助工具，旨在提升病理学家在有丝分裂计数中的效率与一致性。回顾性研究显示，使用MitPro后，组内相关系数从0.589提升至0.949，单次评估平均节省151.8秒，且评分变化频率与常规阅片者间变异相当，证明其作为辅助工具在常规实践中具有可行性和有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有丝分裂计数是多种肿瘤分级、诊断和预后评估的重要组成部分，但人工评估耗时且存在显著的病理学家间差异（inter-pathologist variability）。为解决这些挑战，需开发一种能提高效率并保持一致性的辅助工具。

Method: 开发名为MitPro的AI工具，通过指引病理学家关注预测有丝分裂活性最高的区域并高亮显示有丝分裂图像来辅助工作，同时保留病理学家对区域选择和最终计数的控制权。研究采用回顾性、非干预性配对读者研究设计，包含来自3个国家3个中心的385张全切片图像（涵盖7种肿瘤类型及3种不同扫描仪），由13名病理学家参与。每位病理学家在无AI辅助下独立评估每张幻灯片，并在至少2周的洗脱期后再次使用AI辅助进行评估。

Result: 1. **一致性显著提升**：所有幻灯片的组内相关系数（ICC）从0.589提高至0.949。
2. **效率大幅提高**：病理学家层面的中位评估时间均值从286.4秒降至127.8秒，每次评估平均节省151.8秒。
3. **泛化能力验证**：在使用HALO AP和Sectra图像管理系统的支持分析以及主研究人群之外的2种额外肿瘤类型中，观察到了类似的协议和效率改进。
4. **结果偏移分析**：AI辅助评估导致有丝分裂计数和评分轻微向高分段偏移，这与识别出更多活跃有丝分裂热点及减少漏检相符。评分改变的发生率与常规计数中的阅片者间变异相当。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持将MitPro用作常规实践中更一致、高效的有丝分裂评估辅助工具，能够有效解决人工评估中的变异性问题并提升工作效率。

Abstract: Mitotic counting is an important component of tumour grading, diagnosis and prognostic assessment across several tumour types, but manual assessment is time-consuming and subject to inter-pathologist variability. To help address these challenges, we developed MitPro, an AI tool designed to improve consistency and efficiency by directing pathologists towards regions with the highest predicted mitotic activity and highlighting mitotic figures for review, while retaining pathologist control over region selection and the final count. We evaluated its effect on the reproducibility and efficiency of mitotic counting in a retrospective, non-interventional, paired reader study comprising 385 whole-slide images from 3 centres in 3 countries and 7 tumour types using 3 different scanners. 13 pathologists participated, with each slide assessed independently by 3 pathologists without AI assistance and again with AI assistance after a minimum 2 week washout period. Across all slides, AI-assisted counting increased the intraclass correlation coefficient from 0.589 to 0.949. Mean pathologist-level median assessment time decreased from 286.4 to 127.8 seconds, corresponding to an average saving of 151.8 seconds per assessment. Improvements in agreement and efficiency were also observed in supporting analyses using HALO AP and Sectra image management systems and in 2 additional tumour types outside the main study population. AI-assisted assessment was associated with a subtle shift towards higher mitotic counts and scores, consistent with identification of more active mitotic hotspots and fewer missed mitotic figures. The frequency of score change between unassisted and AI-assisted assessment was comparable with inter-pathologist variation during routine counting. These findings support the use of MitPro as an assistive tool for more consistent and efficient mitotic assessment in routine practice.

</details>


### [415] [Continuous Process-Level Evaluation for Evolving Enterprise AI Agent Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01833)
*Ngoc Phuoc An Vo,Aarya Doshi,Vadim Sheinin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种结合结果级和过程级的企业AI代理持续评估框架，发现92%以上通过最终检查的测试用例仍存在过程偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决企业AI代理技能在工具API、模型和规格变更时，仅靠最终输出评估无法捕捉过程层面行为漂移的问题。

Method: 构建包含结果级和过程级检查的持续评估框架，对“收入”和“生产力”变体进行实验；通过程序化检查和限定范围的LLM裁判，独立计算每轮真实值，评估工具选择、参数、执行顺序及数据库完整性。

Result: 在240次试验中，175次通过最终数值检查的样本里，92.6%存在其他检测到的偏差；在更广泛的七项最终状态定义下，92.1%通过运行的轨迹检查仍违规。依赖归因将平均每轮失败检查从6.34降至2.65个根因。

Conclusion: 该框架能有效识别仅靠最终评估遗漏的过程偏差，提供跨配置的回归覆盖；未来需在实际API演进下进行纵向验证。

Abstract: Enterprise AI agent skills evolve as tool APIs, models, and specifications change, yet final-output evaluation can miss process-level behavioral drift. We present a continuous evaluation framework combining outcome-level and process-level checks, applied to Revenue and Productivity variants of a Business Value Determination skill in an enterprise Value Aware Resiliency system. The framework independently computes per-run ground truth, materializes reusable template tests, and evaluates tool selection, arguments, execution order, and database integrity through programmatic checks and a narrowly scoped LLM judge. We evaluate 240 trials across two skills, two specification variants, two agent harnesses, and three models. Of 175 trials passing all applicable final numerical checks, 162 (92.6 percent; Wilson 95 percent CI: 87.7-95.6 percent) contained another evaluator-detected deviation. Under a broader seven-check final-state definition, 151 of 164 passing runs (92.1 percent; 95 percent CI: 86.9-95.3 percent) still violated a trajectory check. Dependency attribution reduced a mean of 6.34 failed checks per run to 2.65 roots. Specification sensitivity varied by model and harness, with exploratory bootstrap interaction intervals excluding zero for all three Revenue comparisons and one of three Productivity comparisons. Runtime-resolved templates provided reusable regression coverage across the evaluated configurations; longitudinal validation under actual API evolution remains future work.

</details>


### [416] [Code Owns the Simulation, Jev Owns the Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01834)
*Yaodong Yang,Hongyao Tang,Yi Ma,Xingyu Fan,Weixun Wang,Jinpeng Li,Tianpei Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究揭示了Judgment模型（如Jev）在决策中的能力边界：擅长基于已有信息的“评估”，但无法独立进行“模拟”。通过结合代码进行预测，可使其成为专家级控制器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 判断模型因其单次调用即可返回选项概率且无需推理文本，被视为极具吸引力的智能体行动选择层，但其可信决策范围尚不明确。

Method: 在反思测试、单矩阵博弈、ALFWorld文本游戏及机器人控制任务中测试Jev模型的表现，分析其在不同决策场景下的成功率与失败原因。

Result: Jev在仅需“评估”输入信息的任务中表现优异（如99%的反直觉认知反思测试题正确率）；但在需“模拟”未提供信息（如对手动作或前置子目标）的任务中表现次优。其失败并非源于知识缺失，而是因单次调用无法同时完成模拟与评估。当由代码提供预测（如前瞻搜索或物理模拟）时，Jev能发挥其通用评估能力成为专家控制器。

Conclusion: Jev模型的局限性在于无法独立进行情境模拟。建议让代码负责预测或模拟环节，而将评估任务交给Jev，从而构建更可靠的混合决策架构。

Abstract: Judgment models such as \jev{} return, in a single call and without reasoning text, a probability for each described option. This makes them attractive as an agent's action-selection layer, but it is unclear which decisions they can be trusted with. We test \jev{} on reflection tests, one-shot matrix games, the text game ALFWorld and robot control, and find a sharp boundary. \jev{} succeeds when the right option can be judged from what the input describes, which we call \emph{evaluation}. Specifically, it solves 99\% of the counterintuitive Cognitive Reflection Test questions. However, it fails when the right option depends on \emph{simulation} (i.e., predicting something not in the input), such as the opponent's action or the subgoal that must come first. In games, \jev{} plays suboptimally as if its rational opponent acted at random, because the opponent's action is not given. In ALFWorld, \jev{} favors commands that mention an object or place named in the task description. For example, given the task ``put a clean knife in the drawer'', \jev{} carries an unwashed knife straight to the drawer instead of first washing it at the sink. Surprisingly, many of these failures are not due to a lack of knowledge. Asked separately what the opponent will do, \jev{} usually answers correctly, and it responds well given the opponent's action. It fails when one call must both perform the simulation and evaluate based on it. This suggests letting code make the prediction or simulation. When code supplies it, such as a lookahead in ALFWorld and physics simulation in robot control, \jev{} becomes an expert controller through its general evaluation ability.

</details>


### [417] [On the Divergence of Accuracy and Mechanism Consistency in Time Series World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01842)
*Haochen Zhang,Jiaheng Guo,Zhen Xu,Zachary Plotkin,Nicholas Konz,Zhen Tan,Tianlong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出时间序列世界模型（TSWM）的正式化定义与基准测试，发现低预测误差并不保证机制一致性（即对未执行计划的响应符合物理/生理规律）。通过引入方向性监督损失和特定架构设计（冻结潜在空间、门控输出融合），在保持精度的同时显著提升了模型对计划变化的合理响应能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型仅基于已执行计划的预测误差进行训练和评估，缺乏对“未执行计划”响应的测试。研究旨在确定哪些设计选择至关重要，并验证高精度预测器是否能像真实系统一样对改变的计划做出正确响应。

Method: 1. 形式化：分离状态、动作和外生输入，区分连续/模式/事件动作，引入“机制一致性”指标（检查动作变化是否导致预测向已知方向移动）。2. 基准测试：整合8个公共数据集（工程基础设施和临床护理），对比7种骨干网络、5种种子及不同预测空间、计划融合和编码方式。3. 算法改进：引入方向性监督损失（Directional Supervision），惩罚动作偏移后响应符号错误的部分。

Result: 1. 架构影响：冻结潜在预测空间使平均MAE降低9.9%，门控输出融合比输入拼接降低12.7%，而时间计划编码影响极小（2.2%）。2. 误差与一致性背离：最低误差配置在4/5的数据集上机制一致性处于或低于随机水平，且无单一设计能避免此问题。3. 改进效果：方向性监督显著提升受罚机制的一致性，且不增加MAE。

Conclusion: 为构建可靠的时间序列世界模型提供了明确配方：使用冻结潜在空间和输出侧融合以保证准确性，并使用针对机制一致性的训练目标以确保模型对未执行计划具有合理的因果响应能力。

Abstract: A time series world model (TSWM) predicts a controlled system's state from its observed history and planned actions and exogenous inputs. Current approaches build forecasters with actions as covariates, trained and evaluated on prediction error under the executed plan. Yet world models compare unexecuted plans, but their responses to changed plans remain untested. We ask which design choices matter and whether accurate forecasters respond to changed plans as real systems do. We address both with a formalization and benchmark. The formalization separates state, actions and exogenous inputs, distinguishes continuous, mode and event actions, and introduces mechanism consistency, a metric built on declared action-state relations with known directions, such as a vasopressor raising blood pressure: it checks whether shifting an action moves the forecast in the declared direction. The benchmark consolidates eight public datasets with real actions from engineered infrastructure and clinical care, varying prediction space, plan fusion and plan encoding across seven backbones and five seeds. First, a frozen latent prediction space lowers MAE by 9.9% over observation space and gated output fusion lowers it by 12.7% over input concatenation on average, with both improving all eight datasets; temporal plan encoding changes average MAE by at most 2.2%. Second, prediction error and mechanism consistency diverge: the lowest-error configuration is at or below chance in consistency on four of five datasets with declared mechanisms, and no design choice avoids this. Finally, directional supervision, a loss penalizing the wrong-signed part of the response to a shifted action, significantly raises consistency on penalized mechanisms with no change in MAE. Together they give TSWMs a recipe: a frozen latent space and output-side fusion for accuracy, and a training objective for mechanism consistency.

</details>


### [418] [Temporal-Difference Learning for Dragonchess](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01845)
*Jim O'Connor,Annika Hoag,Sarah Goyette,Gary B. Parker*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究通过重构Dragonchess引擎至C++以提升性能，验证了进化迁移学习和TD(lambda)两种自适应AI方法在三维复杂棋类环境中的有效性，结果显示两者均优于其他智能体且彼此间无显著差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究自适应AI方法（进化迁移学习和TD(lambda）在具有独特棋盘结构和计算负载的三维棋类游戏Dragonchess中更新评估启发式规则的表现，以研究其在新颖环境下的适应能力。

Method: 1. 将Dragonchess游戏引擎从PyGame重写为C++以提高运行速度；2. 进行10,000场游戏的循环赛，并采用置信区间和显著性检验进行统计分析；3. 对比进化迁移学习、TD(lambda与其他智能体的表现。

Result: 两种自适应方法在循环赛中均优于所有其他智能体；进化评估与学习评估之间在性能上无显著差异。

Conclusion: 证明了自适应方法在结构复杂的新颖游戏领域中的有效性。

Abstract: Our research investigates how two adaptive AI methods, evolutionary transfer learning and TD(lambda), perform in the three-dimensional chess environment Dragonchess. The game challenges players with its unique board structure and computational load, making it an ideal setting to study how adaptive methods can update evaluation heuristics in novel environments. In this work we re-implement the Dragonchess engine, changing it from a PyGame engine to C++. This enables faster gameplay, allowing us to run 10,000 games with confidence intervals and significance tests, rather than a single small tournament. Both adaptive methods outperform all other agents in the round-robin tournament. Our results showed that there is no significant difference in the performance between the evolved and learned evaluations. This research establishes the efficacy of adaptive methods in structurally complex, novel game domains.

</details>


### [419] [AVSD-Scenes: A Dataset for Audio-Visual Description of Urban Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01861)
*Dhanunjaya Varma Devalraju,Arshdeep Singh,Mark D. Plumbley*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了AVSD-Scenes数据集，利用Qwen系列大模型生成城市环境的配对音视频场景描述。实验表明，多模态描述在语义对齐和跨模态检索上优于单模态，且在场景分类中达到94.5%-95.4%的高准确率，证明其能捕捉真实的音视频语义而非仅反映标签信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管自然语言描述能提供丰富的音视频场景语义，但目前缺乏同时涵盖听觉和视觉信息的联合描述数据集，限制了相关研究的发展。

Method: 基于TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes数据集构建AVSD-Scenes。首先使用Qwen2-Audio-7B和Qwen2.5-VL-7B分别生成音频和视觉描述，随后利用Qwen3-14B、Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506和Gemma-3-27B-it等大语言模型融合生成多模态描述。通过语义对齐、跨模态检索、场景分类及人工评估进行基准测试。

Result: 多模态描述在语义对齐和跨模态检索性能上优于单模态描述；在城市场景分类任务中准确率达94.5%，结合音视频与描述嵌入后提升至95.4%；生成的描述具有高度的场景判别性，且不依赖于提示中的场景标签。

Conclusion: AVSD-Scenes数据集成功填补了联合音视频描述数据的空白，验证了通过大模型融合多模态特征可有效提升语义理解能力，并证明了生成的描述能够深层捕捉音视频内容的真实语义信息。

Abstract: Natural language descriptions can provide rich semantic representations of audio-visual urban scenes, yet datasets that jointly describe both auditory and visual information remain limited. In this paper, we introduce AVSD-Scenes, a paired audio-visual scene description dataset for urban environments. The dataset contains 12,291 audio-visual scene descriptions generated from the TAU Urban Audio-Visual Scenes dataset. To construct the dataset, we first generate audio- and visual-based descriptions using Qwen2-Audio-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, respectively. These modality-specific descriptions are then combined using large language models, namely Qwen3-14B, Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506, and Gemma-3-27B-it, to produce multimodal descriptions that capture complementary information from both modalities. We benchmark AVSD-Scenes using semantic alignment, cross-modal retrieval, scene classification, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and human subjective assessment. Results show that multimodal descriptions improve semantic alignment and cross-modal retrieval performance compared with modality-specific descriptions while preserving strong scene-discriminative information. The generated descriptions achieve up to 94.5% accuracy in urban scene classification, while combining audio, visual, and description embeddings further improves accuracy to 95.4%. Furthermore, the descriptions remain highly scene-discriminative even when scene labels are removed from the prompting instructions, indicating that they capture semantic information derived from the audio-visual content rather than merely reflecting label information.

</details>


### [420] [Mapping the RAG Landscape: A Four Axis Taxonomy of Efficiency, Defense, Interactivity, and Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01936)
*Meghana Sunil,Shravya V,Shravan Venkatraman,Joe Dhanith PR*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文综述了检索增强生成（RAG）的最新进展，提出包含检索效率、鲁棒性安全、交互工作及复杂推理四个维度的分类法，并探讨了评估实践、应用场景及未来挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决大语言模型（LLMs）知识静态和幻觉问题；现有综述多聚焦基础架构，缺乏对超越基础设计的更广泛挑战和能力的系统性梳理。

Method: 构建四轴分类法（效率、安全、交互、推理）；形式化RAG关键组件；回顾密集/稀疏检索、融合策略、嵌入优化及强化学习策略；综合评估方法与应用场景。

Result: 系统整理了Naive、Advanced和Modular等架构变体；明确了检索质量、可靠性、领域适应、可扩展性和可解释性等持续存在的挑战。

Conclusion: 指出了构建更可靠、适应性强且透明的RAG系统的机会，为后续研究提供了结构化视角和未来方向。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable fluency across many tasks but remain limited by their static, parameter bound knowledge and their susceptibility to hallucinating information. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses these issues by incorporating external retrieval into the generation process, grounding model outputs in verifiable and up to date sources. While prior surveys primarily focus on core RAG architectures and standard pipelines, recent research explores broader challenges and capabilities that extend beyond these foundational designs. This survey provides a consolidated and structured examination of contemporary RAG developments, organizing the field into a four axis taxonomy: improving retrieval efficiency, strengthening robustness and security, supporting user driven and interactive workflows, and enabling multi step or complex reasoning. We formalize key components of the RAG framework and review methods spanning dense and sparse retrieval, fusion strategies, embedding optimizations, and reinforcement learning based retrieval policies, highlighting how these advances influence practical deployment and system design. We also synthesize evaluation practices, domain specific applications, and architectural variants such as Naive, Advanced, and Modular RAG. Finally, we outline persistent challenges related to retrieval quality, reliability, domain adaptation, scalability, and explainability, and identify opportunities for building RAG systems that are more reliable, adaptable, and transparent.

</details>


### [421] [Counterfactual Auditing of Bias in Open-Source Large Language Models for Clinical Triage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01963)
*Manar Aljohani,Brandon Ho,Kenneth McKinley,Dennis Ren,Xuan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 通过对10个开源大型语言模型（LLMs）进行反事实审计，研究发现偏见敏感度并未随模型规模或医学领域预训练而一致降低；微调模型Qwen2.5-7B表现最佳，证明反事实审计是评估开源LLM公平性风险的轻量级框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 急诊分诊是高利害权的优先排序任务，人口统计学和社会经济因素可能不当影响病情严重程度的分配。尽管开源LLMs被用于临床决策支持，但其跨不同模型家族、大小及领域适应模型的“反事实偏见”差异尚不明确。

Method: 对10个开源LLMs（包括Qwen系列、MedGemma、MedLLaMA2、GPT-OSS等）进行对比反事实审计。基于真实和手册式临床案例构建配对反事实变体，仅改变单一的人口统计、社会经济或系统背景变量，固定临床表现。测量指标包括任何反事实偏移率、漏诊/误诊率、超过一个ESI级别的偏移、平均偏移及平均绝对偏移。

Result: 反事实敏感度存在显著差异，且未随模型增大或医学预训练而系统性降低。QLoRA微调的Qwen2.5-7B整体敏感度最低（任何偏移率5.27%，平均绝对偏移0.0534），优于基线模型（16.02%，0.1706）。部分较大或医学领域模型显示出更显著的偏移。分层分析揭示了隐藏于聚合数据中的方向性偏差和共同失败模式。

Conclusion: 反事实审计是一种轻量级、具有临床可解释性的框架，可用于在临床部署前比较开源LLMs的公平性风险。研究强调了在部署前评估模型偏见的重要性，特别是对于非微调的基础大模型。

Abstract: Emergency department (ED) triage is a high-stakes prioritization task in which demographic, socioeconomic, and system-context information may improperly influence acuity assignment. Although open-source large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for local and privacy-preserving clinical decision support, it remains unclear how counterfactual bias varies across model families, sizes, medical-domain models, and domain-adapted models. We present a comparative counterfactual audit of ten open-source LLMs for pediatric Emergency Severity Index (ESI) prediction. Starting from real and handbook-style clinical vignettes, we construct paired counterfactual variants that change only one injected demographic, socioeconomic, healthcare-access, behavioral, social, or system-context variable while holding the clinical presentation fixed. Models include Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, a QLoRA fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B, MedGemma variants, MedLLaMA2-7B, GPT-OSS-20B, and GPT-OSS-120B. We measure any counterfactual shift, undertriage, overtriage, shifts greater than one ESI level, mean shift, and mean absolute shift. Counterfactual sensitivity varied substantially and did not consistently decrease with larger model size or medical-domain pretraining. The fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B showed the lowest overall sensitivity, with a 5.27% any-shift rate and mean absolute shift of 0.0534, versus 16.02% and 0.1706 for the base model. Several larger or medical-domain models showed more significant shifts. Stratified and correlation analyses further revealed clinically important directionality and shared failure patterns hidden by aggregate rates. These findings support counterfactual auditing as a lightweight, clinically interpretable framework for comparing fairness risks in open-source LLMs before clinical deployment.

</details>


### [422] [Can AI Oversight Be Zero Knowledge?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01995)
*Alessandro Chiesa,Ziyi Guan,Burcu Yildiz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了在存在“神谕”（如人类判断、物理实验）辅助的AI计算中，如何在不泄露机密数据的前提下验证输出正确性。研究证明了通用零知识证明的不可能性，但提出了一种基于神谕签名的有效解决方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI系统越来越多地基于机密数据生成输出（如医疗记录评估或药物预测），需要在不泄露底层数据的情况下验证这些输出的正确性。现有工作主要关注高效验证，但受限于额外假设；本文旨在探索允许验证者运行时间多项式于计算时间的情况下，能否实现零知识验证以保护隐私。

Method: 1. 理论分析：在随机预言机模型下，通过证明论据分析通用神谕辅助计算的零知识特性。
2. 方案设计：提出一种新的协议框架，要求神谟对其每个回答附加密码学签名。
3. 安全性证明：基于碰撞抵抗哈希函数，证明该方案可实现零知识验证。

Result: 1. 不可能性结果：证明了在一般情况下，神谕辅助计算不存在零知识证明，即使在随机预言机模型下且允许 prover 和 verifier 运行更长时间，这一结论也适用于辩论（debate）模型。
2. 可能性结果：如果神谕对每个回答进行密码学签名，则可以在仅假设碰撞抵抗哈希函数的情况下，实现具有高效 prover 和 verifier 的零知识验证。

Conclusion: 虽然通用的零知识验证在理论上不可行，但通过引入神谕签名机制，可以实现安全、可扩展的监督方法。该方法不依赖于诚实的对手（如辩论模型）或计算的鲁棒性（如先前的单证明者协议），为机密数据的AI输出验证提供了新的隐私保护途径。

Abstract: AI systems increasingly produce outputs from confidential data, such as a fitness-for-duty assessment from medical records or the predicted properties of a drug candidate from its secret structure. It is important to verify that such outputs are correct without revealing the underlying data. A recent line of work studies verification of AI outputs via interactive proofs and debate for oracle-aided computation, where correctness may depend on an oracle such as human judgment, a physical experiment, or the web. These works focus on verification by a verifier that runs much faster than the computation. However, such efficient verification is impossible for general oracle-aided computation, and these works therefore rely on additional assumptions. We focus instead on privacy: allowing the verifier to run in time polynomial in the computation, we ask whether interactive arguments for oracle-aided computation can be zero knowledge, so that the verifier learns nothing about the confidential data beyond the correctness of the output.
  We prove that, in general, they cannot. In the random oracle model, there are no zero-knowledge proofs for all oracle-aided computations, even if both the prover and the verifier are allowed to run much longer than the computation itself. The impossibility extends to debate, a canonical model for scalable oversight.
  On the positive side, we show that if the oracle attaches a cryptographic signature to each of its answers, then every oracle-aided computation can be verified in zero knowledge with an efficient prover and verifier, assuming only collision-resistant hash functions. Beyond privacy, this also gives an alternative approach to scalable oversight that relies neither on an honest opponent, as in debate, nor on the robustness of the computation, as in prior single-prover protocols.

</details>


### [423] [Mingbird: A Local-First Agent Harness Enabling Small Open Models to Complete Real Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02001)
*Hao Wang,Ting Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Mingbird，一种面向本地小模型（2-9B）的Agent框架，通过十项机制解决上下文溢出、自我修正发散等问题，在控制变量对比中显著优于现有框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小型开源模型在云端Agent环境中常因工具预填充溢出、自我修正发散、演示循环及任务静默放弃等原因失败，且现有研究难以区分是模型能力不足还是Harness（执行框架）设计缺陷所致。

Method: 开发Mingbird本地优先Agent Harness，引入三项代表性机制：字节级零预填充预算、完成前重读任务的结束门控、以及签名级循环检测。通过LRAB基准测试（固定机器、模型、预算和评分标准，对比4种Harness与4种开放模型在18个真实任务上的表现）进行严格评估。

Result: 在LRAB测试中，Mingbird整体得分为0.886，显著高于goose (0.631)、opencode (0.479)和agent-mini (0.405)。在τ²-bench上得分0.856，亦优于对比组。消融实验显示完整机制栈具有正向增益，但受限于单样本评分波动，具体机制贡献需进一步验证。

Conclusion: 大量小模型在Agent任务中的失败可归因于Harness设计而非模型本身。Mingbird通过针对性机制有效提升了小模型的执行成功率，证明了优化执行框架对释放小模型潜力的重要性，尽管当前证据受限于单一机器和自建基准。

Abstract: Small open-weight models (2-9B) run on ordinary laptops, but under cloud-scale agent harnesses they rarely complete real tasks: tool prefill overflows the context, self-correction diverges, tool demonstrations loop, and tasks are silently abandoned. We present evidence, from a controlled single-machine comparison and one third-party benchmark, that a substantial share of these failures is attributable to the harness rather than the model. We introduce Mingbird, a local-first agent harness for Windows and Ollama whose ten mechanisms compensate point-by-point for small-model failure forms, three of them representative: a byte-level net-zero prefill budget, a finish gate that re-reads the task before accepting completion, and signature-level loop detection. On LRAB, a controlled comparison holding machine, models, budgets, and scoring fixed (4 harnesses $\times$ 4 open models (2B-35B) $\times$ 18 real tasks, deterministic artifact scoring), Mingbird reaches 0.886 overall against 0.631 (goose), 0.479 (opencode), and 0.405 (agent-mini), with all 288 cells published; on $τ^2$-bench (278 tasks, three arms, one protocol) it totals 0.856 against 0.791 and 0.737; and a frontier-model probe on the same 18 tasks spans 0.997 to 0.478 across harnesses, with well-formed scaffolds staying within 0.072 of each other. A leave-one-mechanism-out ablation is reported as directional only: same-night replications of the same arm move its mean by up to 0.069, the size of every nominal single-trial delta, and the one batch-matched comparison (full mechanism stack versus text re-read alone) gives the executable completion guards a paired +0.10 across three replications. The evidence carries stated limits: a self-built benchmark, a single machine, and single-trial scoring.

</details>


### [424] [Counting Moves, Weighing Voices: Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation for Calibrated Multi-LLM Councils under Persistent Adversaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02005)
*Ionel Eduard Stan,Paolo Napoletano*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出贝叶斯辩证论证（BDA）方法，通过评估多LLM辩论中各代理的可靠性来生成校准后的置信度，解决了现有方法置信度未校准及无法应对不可靠代理的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多LLM委员会聚合方法在两个方面存在缺陷：一是其置信度衡量的是决断力而非正确性概率；二是无法识别或降低持续不可靠代理的影响，导致决策鲁棒性不足。

Method: 将委员会的类型化行动（提议、挑战、让步）视为具有每代理可靠性的经典标注器模型的观察值，将多代理协商重构为可靠性估计问题，利用协商轨迹推断代理可靠性并据此加权证据。

Result: 在二分类和多类基准测试中，BDA实现了零成本（无需额外LLM调用）聚合方法中的最佳校准效果，并在持续对抗联盟下提高了鲁棒性，同时在清洁设置中保持竞争力。

Conclusion: BDA通过将多智能体协商转化为可靠性估计问题，不仅提供了校准后的后验概率，还能有效处理持久不可靠代理，优于现有的零成本聚合方法。

Abstract: A multi-LLM \emph{council} lets several large language models (LLMs) deliberate on a question and return an answer together with a confidence estimate. As these systems become increasingly used for reasoning, that confidence should represent a calibrated \emph{probability of being correct}, and the decision should remain robust when some agents are persistently unreliable. Existing \emph{council aggregation} methods fail on both fronts: their confidence estimates measure decisiveness rather than correctness, and they cannot identify or discount persistently unreliable agents. We introduce Bayesian Dialectical Argumentation (BDA), which treats the council's \emph{typed} moves---who proposed, challenged, or conceded which answer---as observations of a classical annotator model with \emph{per-agent} reliabilities. This formulation recasts multi-agent deliberation as a reliability estimation problem, using the deliberation trace to infer agent reliability under persistent adversarial behavior. By weighting evidence according to inferred agent reliability, BDA yields calibrated posterior probabilities over candidate answers while allowing persistently unreliable agents to be inverted rather than merely outvoted. Across binary and multi-class benchmarks, BDA achieves the best calibration among zero-cost council aggregation methods, requiring no additional LLM calls, and improves robustness under persistent adversarial coalitions while remaining competitive in clean settings.

</details>


### [425] [Atoms to Processes: The Role of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Chemical Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02014)
*Michael Baldea,Linda J. Broadbelt,Marianthi G. Ierapetritou,Akhilesh Jain,Ankur Kumar,Thomas A. Kwan,Fèlix Llovell,Andrew J. Medford,Ilias Mitrai,Joel Paulson,Junyi Qiao,Matthew P. Rivera,Kirti C. Sahu,Lev Sarkisov,Zachary P. Smith,Calvin Tsay,Ching-Mei Wen,Victor M. Zavala,Huacheng Zhang,Dan Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 文章综述了AI/ML在化学工程中的应用，强调从纯黑盒模型向结合第一性原理的混合框架转变，以解决准确性、数据稀缺等问题，最终实现人机协作与领域知识的增强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI和机器学习技术的成熟，其在化学工程各领域的渗透日益加深，但面临预测准确性、数据稀缺、外推能力、可解释性及模型生命周期管理等挑战，亟需方法论上的整合与视角更新。

Method: 提供近期方法学发展和代表性应用的视角分析，重点探讨如何将AI/ML工具与第一性原理模型相结合，特别是发展尊重守恒定律、热力学一致性和结构约束的物理信息框架。

Result: 识别出跨领域的一致趋势：从纯黑盒方法转向混合和物理信息框架；这些方法提高了鲁棒性和可靠性，并通过提供适当抽象层级的信息促进了有意义的人机协作。

Conclusion: AI和ML并未取代化学工程的核心原则，而是对其进行了放大和增强；未来实现自主、适应性和可持续系统的关键在于深思熟虑地将AI/ML与第一性原理理解及领域专业知识相结合。

Abstract: The rapid maturation of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) has catalyzed a profound shift in how chemical engineering problems are formulated, analyzed, and solved. Advances in computing, data availability, and learning algorithms have enabled AI/ML methods to impact applications spanning atomic-scale simulations, materials and catalyst discovery, transport and thermodynamics, separations, process systems engineering, and industrial operations. This article provides a perspective on recent methodological developments and representative applications, emphasizing how AI/ML tools are being integrated with first-principles models to address challenges of predictive accuracy, data scarcity, extrapolation, interpretability, and model lifecycle management. Across domains, a unifying trend is the move away from purely black-box approaches toward hybrid and physics-informed frameworks that explicitly respect conservation laws, thermodynamic consistency, and known structural constraints. These approaches not only improve robustness and reliability, but also enable meaningful human-AI collaboration by providing information at an appropriate level of abstraction for the task and decision context. We conclude that AI and ML are not replacing the core principles of chemical engineering; rather, they are amplifying them. As the field advances toward increasingly autonomous, adaptive, and sustainable systems, the thoughtful integration of AI/ML with first-principles understanding and domain expertise will be essential to realizing their full potential across both research and industrial practice.

</details>


### [426] [SPHERE: Adaptive VR Indoor Scene Generation via LLM-Enhanced Spatial Preference Learning and Human-in-the-Loop RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02023)
*Hyeonmin Lee,Zheng Wei,Kyungmin Kwon,Jumin Seo,Jiwon Park,Hayoung Oh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SPHERE是一个自适应VR生成框架，通过从自然多模态交互中提取持久空间偏好，将孤立的3D场景合成转化为持续的人机共创，显著减少修正编辑和身体疲劳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型（LLM）驱动的3D室内场景合成管线无法跨会话保留用户特定偏好，导致沉浸式创作过程重复且造成身体疲劳。

Method: 提出SPHERE框架：1) 从语音和控制器编辑等多模态交互中提取持久空间偏好；2) 将原始编辑抽象为分层约束，以建模局部功能和全局拓扑上下文，确保几何弹性；3) 采用人在回路强化学习机制，根据用户最终编辑场景动态更新检索策略。

Result: 混合设计用户研究（N=42）和离线消融实验表明，SPHERE显著减少了修正编辑次数和身体需求，避免了对浅层对象特征的偏见，生成了具有几何弹性且符合用户画像的布局。

Conclusion: SPHERE证明了捕捉演示的空间逻辑能够实现可控的空间适应，为沉浸式创作建立了一个可靠、受控的人机协作框架。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) advance 3D indoor scene synthesis, current pipelines fail to retain user-specific preferences across sessions, making immersive authoring a repetitive and physically fatiguing process. We present SPHERE, an adaptive VR generation framework that transforms isolated synthesis into continuous human-AI co-creation. SPHERE extracts persistent spatial preferences from natural multimodal interactions (speech and controller edits). To ensure geometric resilience against spatial distortions, it abstracts these raw edits into hierarchical constraints modeling both local functional and global topological contexts. Furthermore, a human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning mechanism dynamically updates retrieval policies based on the user's final edited scenes. A mixed-design user study ($N=42$) and an offline ablation demonstrate that SPHERE significantly reduces corrective edits and physical demand, preventing bias toward shallow object-level traits to yield geometrically resilient, profile-aligned layouts. Ultimately, SPHERE demonstrates how capturing demonstrated spatial logic enables controlled spatial adaptation, establishing a reliable, governed human-AI collaboration framework for immersive authoring. Project page and source code will be available at: https://github.com/hyeonmin11/SPHERE

</details>


### [427] [Global Coherence: When Every Agent Is Right and the Team Is Still Wrong - A Local-to-Global Semantic Foundation for Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02036)
*Xin Heng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AI智能体面临“全局一致性”问题，即局部决策有效但联合结果无效。本文提出“观察别名不可能定理”，指出若不可区分的世界需要互斥动作，则最大成功率为1/k，且无法通过增强模型推理弥补。为此设计了包含拓扑、范畴、群胚、层和最小历史的运行时语义框架（Harness），并通过九个实验验证了拥有共享状态比单纯提升局部智能更关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决AI智能体在做出局部有效决策时，因缺乏共享状态而导致联合产生无效结果的问题，即“全局一致性”问题。旨在明确这一失败的理论边界，并提供一种能确保全局一致性的机制。

Method: 1. 理论推导：提出“观察别名不可能定理”，界定保证有效动作的精确边界。2. 系统设计：构建局部到全局的运行时语义 X = (H, C, G, F; D)，其中H记录重叠范围，C管理状态变更，G保留可逆翻译，F测试局部视图是否拼接为单一世界，D仅保留改变合法未来的历史区别。3. 实验验证：通过九项研究（包括受控基准测试、TeamBench和tau2-bench Telecom）对比不同策略下的表现。

Result: 1. 理论证实：当决策事件被隐藏时，即使使用前沿模型，成功率也降至12-17/40（符合随机水平1/3）；恢复权威事实后恢复至40/40。2. 实证效果：在TeamBench中，常规团队多次超预算，而承诺执行机制零违规；在电信基准测试中，Harness得分1.00，而当前状态检查仅0.07。3. 结论验证：在已拥有完整相关状态的常规求解器场景下，其表现与Harness相当。

Conclusion: 局部智能无法替代缺失的全局状态。AI系统的瓶颈往往不在于模型智力本身，而在于共享状态的缺失。通过引入专门的管理机制（Harness）来维护全局一致性和状态可见性，是解决多智能体协作失效的关键。

Abstract: AI agents can each make locally valid decisions yet jointly produce an invalid result. We call this the global coherence problem: a failure of shared state, not merely of model intelligence.
  Our Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem gives the exact boundary. A policy can guarantee a valid action exactly when all worlds producing the same observation share an admissible action. If k indistinguishable worlds require pairwise-disjoint actions, the best randomized worst-case success is 1/k; more reasoning, roles, messages, or samples cannot recover the missing distinction. A stronger model can reason better within its context, but it cannot see beyond it.
  We then give local-to-global runtime semantics X = (H, C, G, F; D): topology H records overlapping scopes; category C governs state-changing actions; groupoid G retains reversible translations; sheaf F tests whether local views glue into one world; and minimal history D keeps only distinctions that alter legal futures. Models propose; the harness owns shared state and governs commit.
  Nine studies test both the failure and its boundary. On a controlled revision benchmark, the same frontier model scores 40/40 when the deciding event is visible; when it is hidden, tested arms score 12--17/40, consistent with chance (1/3); restoring one authoritative fact returns 40/40. On TeamBench, ordinary teams exceed a shared budget in 5/5 runs, a visible live count leaves 4/5 violations, and commit enforcement leaves 0/5. In tau2-bench Telecom, current-state checks score 0.07 after silent reverts, while the harness scores 1.00. Where a conventional solver already owns the complete relevant state, it ties the harness as predicted. The counterintuitive conclusion is that local intelligence cannot substitute for missing global state.

</details>


### [428] [Mimir: Physics-Grounded LLM Agents for Long-Horizon Irrigation Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02038)
*Yimeng Liu,Mi Zhang,Younsuk Dong,Zhichao Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Mimir，一种基于物理的LLM智能体，通过快速数值验证和慢速经验积累机制，在长期灌溉控制中实现低成本节水，证明结构化物理接口优于单纯扩大模型规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体研究多集中于有即时反馈和重置机制的短程任务，缺乏对长期物理控制（如错误累积、状态依赖且不可重写物理规则）的研究。旨在解决此类长周期、高风险的物理环境下的自主决策问题。

Method: 构建Mimir智能体，包含两个修复时间尺度：1. 快速时间尺度：利用结构化物理接口和确定性模拟器，对LLM输出进行数值检查、修订及有界确定性动作选择；2. 慢速时间尺度：将重复性失败模式整合为持久化的上下文原则，以引导未来提议，同时保持物理模型和执行约束不变。

Result: 在多站点、作物和年份的评估中，Mimir实现了最低的聚合控制成本，相比历史调度回放方案减少约51%的灌溉用水量。消融实验证实正向仿真、验证修订和持久化上下文的重要性；模型规模研究表明LLM大小与控制性能无单调正相关。

Conclusion: 持久的物理智能体能够将语义推理与有界的、基于证据的自我改进相结合，但必须将物理真理和执行器权限保留给明确的数值机制，以确保安全性和有效性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly combine reasoning, tool use, and action, but most evidence comes from episodic tasks with relatively immediate feedback and reset failures. Long-running physical control operates in a different regime: actions alter future states, errors compound across decisions, and an agent must improve from experience without being allowed to rewrite the physical rules that make execution safe. We study this regime through irrigation, where daily decisions interact with soil-water dynamics over entire growing seasons. We present Mimir, a physics-grounded LLM agent organized around two repair timescales. At the fast timescale, a structured physical interface and deterministic simulator turn an LLM output into a proposal that we numerically check, revise, and subject to bounded deterministic action selection before execution. At the slow timescale, recurrent failure patterns are consolidated into persistent contextual principles that condition future proposals, while the physical model, evaluator, and execution constraints remain immutable. Under a common retrospective evaluator across multiple sites, crops, and years, Mimir attains the lowest reported aggregate control cost among the evaluated references and uses about 51% less irrigation than the historical schedule replay. The ablation study show higher control cost when forward simulation, verified revision, or persistent context is removed; model-scale and model-family studies show no monotonic gain from increasing LLM size. The resulting lesson show that persistent physical agents can combine semantic reasoning with bounded, evidence-driven self-improvement while reserving physical truth and actuator authority for explicit numerical mechanisms.

</details>


### [429] [HydroJEV: A one-second, training-free screen for cyber-attack and fault attribution in water distribution networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02048)
*Tianwei Mu,Shengyan Jiang,Mingzhe Yuan,Qing Luo,Min Xiao,Wenhong Wang,Jun Li,Manhong Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究提出了一种名为Jev的免训练模型，用于SCADA警报的快速分类。在C-Town网络基准测试中，Jev在速度和准确性上优于监督分类器和大型语言模型（LLMs），并能有效减少后续人工或复杂模型审核的工作量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在供水管网中，面对SCADA警报，操作员需快速判断是网络攻击、物理故障、正常瞬变还是传感器故障。现有监督分类器缺乏标注数据，而前沿大语言模型（LLMs）决策耗时过长（数十秒），无法满足实时性要求。

Method: 测试了免训练模型Jev作为初步分诊工具的性能。基于EPANET中的C-Town网络构建了四类归因基准，将Jev与手写规则树、监督分类器及七种云端LLM进行对比。实验包括四个密封预注册轮次，并在两个额外网络中进行迁移测试。

Result: 1. Jev匹配了规则树的性能（宏观F1分数0.62-0.64 vs 0.56-0.61）。
2. 对于标签中缺失的事件子类型，Jev比监督分类器高出0.36-0.42的F1分数。
3. 当每类标注事件少于约4个时，Jev表现优于分类器。
4. Jev的决策速度比前沿LLMs快20-40倍（约1秒）。
5. 结合规则树验证Jev的结果，可将LLM审核工作量减少35-38%，且未降低宏观F1分数。
6. 迁移至其他网络后，该级联方法仍保持在非劣效范围内。

Conclusion: 一种快速的免训练筛查模型可以承担SCADA异常分诊中约三分之一的审核负荷，同时保持 deliberate review（深思熟虑的审核）的准确性，为资源受限环境下的实时安全响应提供了高效解决方案。

Abstract: When a SCADA alarm is raised in a water distribution network, operators must decide quickly whether it reflects a cyberattack, a physical fault, a normal transient or a faulty sensor. Supervised classifiers need labelled incidents that utilities rarely have, and frontier large language models (LLMs) take tens of seconds per decision. We tested whether Jev, a training-free model that returns class probabilities in about one second, can serve as the first tier of this triage. On a four-class cause-attribution benchmark built on the C-Town network in EPANET, Jev was compared with a hand-written rule tree, a supervised classifier and seven cloud LLMs on identical evidence in four sealed, pre-registered rounds. With only a label-free prior correction, Jev matched the rule tree (macro-F1 0.62-0.64 against 0.56-0.61 in distribution) and exceeded the supervised classifier by 0.36-0.42 on event subtypes absent from its labels, in all four rounds, and it outperformed the classifier whenever fewer than about four labelled events per class were available. Jev also decided 20-40 times faster than frontier LLMs. Accepting only benign Jev verdicts confirmed by the rule tree spared an LLM reviewer 35-38% of windows on fresh sealed sets without loss of macro-F1. Transferred unchanged to two further networks, this gated cascade stayed within the non-inferiority margin of its reviewer on all four sets. A fast, training-free screen can therefore take over about a third of the review load in SCADA anomaly triage while preserving the accuracy of deliberate review.

</details>


### [430] [External Observers May See More Clearly: Cross-Model Span-Level Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models via Hidden State Probing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02066)
*Kingshuk Gupta,Davide Buscaldi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种基于内部隐藏状态的细粒度（span-level）幻觉检测框架，通过检查逐层激活模式来精确定位大语言模型生成中的幻觉起始和延续token。实验证明该方法在精确率-召回率曲线下面积（PR AUC）上显著优于随机基线，并进一步提出了跨模型检测框架，发现外部观察者模型（甚至更小模型）的幻觉起始定位能力可媲美或超越生成器自身的自我检测能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型（LLM）存在严重的幻觉问题。虽然内部状态探测比外部检索系统更快，但现有方法大多将其简化为token级别的二分类任务，无法捕捉语义漂移的结构化和序列边界，导致检测精度不足。

Method: 1. 构建内部隐藏状态框架，进行细粒度的span-level幻觉检测；2. 检查逐层激活模式以识别确切的幻觉起始和延续token；3. 提出跨模型检测框架，让一个模型观察另一个模型生成时激发的内部表示。

Result: 该方法成功隔离了幻觉起始点，在极端类别不平衡的情况下，实现了显著的Precision-Recall AUC提升。此外，外部观察者模型在定位幻觉起始点方面的表现可以匹配或超过生成器自身的自我检测结果，即使观察者模型规模更小。

Conclusion: 自我检测并非幻觉起始定位能力的上限；利用其他模型（包括更小的模型）观察生成模型的内部表示，可以实现高效且高精度的幻觉检测，为理解LLM内部机制提供了新视角。

Abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as foundational reasoning engines, their tendency to hallucinate remains a critical vulnerability. While recent internal state probes offer a promising alternative to slow external retrieval systems, they largely reduce hallucination detection to a token-wise binary classification task, failing to capture the structured, sequential boundaries of semantic drift. Here, we introduce an internal hidden state framework for fine-grained, span-level hallucination detection. By inspecting layer-wise activation patterns, we attempt to detect the exact hallucination onset and continuation tokens in an LLM generation. Our experiments show that this approach successfully isolates hallucination onsets, achieving substantial improvements in Precision-Recall AUC over random baselines despite extreme class imbalance. Ultimately, we propose a novel cross-model detection framework in which one model observes the internal representations elicited by another model's generation. We find that an external observer can match or exceed a generator's self-detection of its own hallucination onsets, including when the observer is the smaller model, suggesting that self-detection is not the ceiling for onset localisation.

</details>


### [431] [Causal Memory Policy: Making Memory Utility Identifiable by Intervening on Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02070)
*Arman Behnam,Binghui Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出因果记忆策略（CMP），通过干预检索过程解决记忆效用识别问题，显著提升记忆保留决策的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于检索的记忆增强大语言模型存在“检索级正性违反”问题：未被检索的记忆其效用无法被识别，导致依赖检索结果的评估失效。

Method: 引入因果框架CMP，预留固定上下文槽位以已知倾向性采样记忆进行干预；采用自归一化逆倾向加权估计记忆效用，并证明因果分解、无偏性及最优决策规则。

Result: 在LongMemEval和LoCoMo数据集中分别有54%和67%的必要记忆未能被正确识别；CMP将区分必要与非必要记忆的能力从AUC 0.54提升至0.66；发现仅凭查询级效用不足以预测未见查询中的记忆价值。

Conclusion: CMP有效解决了记忆效用的识别难题，但单纯的已识别记忆效用仍不足以支撑鲁棒的长期记忆保留策略，需进一步探索聚合机制。

Abstract: Memory-augmented large language models must decide which memories to retain, and recent systems do so by estimating each memory's effect on task performance. However, these estimates rely entirely on retrieved memories. When a memory is never retrieved, store-level interventions produce identical outcomes, leaving its utility unidentified. This is a retrieval-level positivity violation, invisible to diagnostics that examine only memory operations. We introduce Causal Memory Policy (CMP), a causal framework that restores identification by intervening on retrieval itself, reserving a fixed number of context slots for memories sampled with known propensities. CMP estimates memory utility by self-normalized inverse propensity weighting under a balanced assignment design. We prove the causal factorization of memory utility through retrieval, the unbiasedness and exact variance of the estimator, and the optimal decision rule under irreversible operations. Empirically, identification fails for 54% of required memories on LongMemEval and 67% on LoCoMo, and the failure persists in a deployed memory system. CMP improves discrimination between required and non-required memories from 0.54 to 0.66 AUC. Finally, we show that identified memory utility alone is insufficient for retention decisions: per-query utility reaches 0.78 AUC on the query for which it is estimated, yet no aggregation available to a retention policy predicts a memory's value on unseen queries. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/cmp-release-D0C3/.

</details>


### [432] [PyPottery: an AI-powered end-to-end suite for pottery processing and publication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02072)
*Lorenzo Cardarelli*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了PyPottery，一个开源的AI驱动套件，旨在半自动化考古陶器记录流程。该套件包含四个模块：图像提取与手写识别、铅笔图自动描墨、语义感知矢量化和自动布局生成。在意大利Terramara di Montale的50张手绘图纸（含240幅陶器图）上的评估显示，用户报告中位效率提升40倍（范围17.5-120倍），证实了AI辅助工具在考古记录中的潜力及认知劳动向增强而非完全自动化的战略转移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 陶瓷材料研究是考古学的基石，但陶器记录的后期制作工作流程依然耗时且造成严重的出版瓶颈。

Method: 提出PyPottery套件，包含四个集成模块：PyPotteryScan（自动图像提取和手写识别）、PyPotteryInk（铅笔图自动描墨）、PyPotteryTrace（语义感知矢量化）和PyPotteryLayout（自动布局生成）。在50张手绘 sheets（240幅陶器图）上进行评估，并通过可用性研究收集用户反馈。

Result: 框架实现了显著的时间节省，用户报告中位感知速度提升40倍（范围17.5x至120x），验证了传统工作流相比下的效率优势。

Conclusion: AI辅助工具在考古记录中具有巨大潜力；研究强调应战略性地将认知劳动从重复性任务重新分配至增强性任务，而非追求完全自动化。

Abstract: The study of ceramic materials constitutes a cornerstone of archaeological research, yet the post-production workflow for pottery documentation remains labor-intensive and creates significant publication bottlenecks. This paper presents PyPottery, an open-source, AI-powered suite designed to semi-automate the complete ceramic documentation pipeline. The suite comprises four integrated modules: PyPotteryScan for automated image extraction and handwriting recognition; PyPotteryInk for automatic inking of pencil drawings; PyPotteryTrace for semantically-aware vectorization; and PyPotteryLayout for automated layout generation. Evaluated on 50 hand-drawn sheets containing 240 pottery drawings from the Terramara di Montale (Italy), the framework achieved substantial time savings confirmed by usability study participants, who reported a median perceived speedup of 40$\times$ over traditional workflows (range: 17.5$\times$--120$\times$). These results highlight the potential of AI-assisted tools in archaeological documentation, while the paper addresses the strategic redistribution of cognitive labor toward augmentation rather than automation.

</details>


### [433] [Homomorphic Advantage Operator: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning Under Fully Homomorphic Encryption Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02074)
*Abid Mohamed Nadhir,Ahmad Al Hanbali,Beggas Mounir*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出同构优势算子（HAO），解决全同态加密（FHE）强化学习中的多项式近似发散问题，实现安全且稳定的隐私保护RL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在云端部署具有机密数据的智能系统面临隐私挑战，FHE虽能提供安全计算，但在应用于强化学习时，非线性的替换会导致“贝尔曼漂移”现象，引发灾难性的递归误差和多项式近似发散。

Method: 引入同构优势算子（HAO），将基于优势的估值中的零均值中心化投影直接应用于时序差分（TD）目标。该方法通过线性投影消除驱动贝尔曼漂移的状态价值基线，无需增加非线性乘法深度或昂贵的密文引导技术。

Result: 实验涵盖表格型MDP、加密CartPole环境及20节点物流路由基准测试。结果显示：HAO严格限制网络预激活值在安全的多项式近似域内；在所有随机种子中边界违规率为0%（相比之下，仅正则化方法在3/5种子中违规，未稳定基线在83.8%的episode中违规）；在表格型领域中最优策略准确率提升18.0个百分点，且在加入DP-SGD风格高斯噪声下保持稳定。

Conclusion: HAO框架有效解决了FHE-based RL中的稳定性问题，实现了零边界违规和高精度的隐私保护强化学习，为云环境下的机密数据智能系统提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Privacy-preserving machine learning presents significant deployment challenges on the cloud for intelligent systems with confidential data. Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) offers a compelling solution for secure computation, preserving data confidentiality of cloud computations. However, applying FHE to reinforcement learning (RL) requires replacing non-linear operations with polynomial approximations, which diverge catastrophically due to a unique recursive error phenomenon known as the Bellman drift. This article introduces the Homomorphic Advantage Operator (HAO), a stabilization framework designed to prevent polynomial approximation divergence in FHE-based deep RL. HAO adapts the zero-mean centering projection from advantage-based value estimation directly to temporal-difference (TD) targets. This linear projection annihilates the uniform state-value baseline that drives the Bellman drift, maintaining per-state action rankings while requiring zero additional non-linear multiplicative depth and avoiding expensive ciphertext bootstrapping. The proposed HAO framework was evaluated using a three-tier experimental methodology, including a tabular Markov Decision Process (MDP), an encrypted CartPole environment using real CKKS cryptographic operations, and a 20-node logistics routing benchmark with dense continuous features. The results demonstrate that the proposed HAO strictly bounds network pre-activations within the safe polynomial approximation domain. The proposed HAO RL agents achieved 0% boundary breaches across all random seeds used, whereas regularization alone (L2 weight decay and gradient clipping) breached the bound on 3 of 5 seeds and the unstabilized baseline did so in 83.8% of episodes. Finally, HAO agents improve optimal policy accuracy by 18.0 percentage points in tabular domains and remain stable when DP-SGD-style Gaussian noise is added to the clipped gradients.

</details>


### [434] [A Comparative Explainability Framework for DeBERTa-v3 in Zero-Shot Medical Abstract Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02116)
*Javier Diaz Esteban-Herreros,David Muñoz-Valero,Raquel Martínez-España,Jose M. Juarez,Juan Moreno-Garcia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个比较可解释性框架，用于审计DeBERTa-v3在医疗摘要零样本分类中的表现。通过对比五种解释方法（SHAP, LIME, occlusion, Input x Gradient, Attention x Gradient）的一致性，发现解释稳定性与预测确定性高度相关，并揭示了模型在语义模糊时的系统性失效机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决可解释人工智能（XAI）中的“分歧问题”，即不同的归因方法对同一输入和预测产生截然不同的解释，导致审计困难。

Method: 1. 在医疗摘要语料库上实现自然语言推理引擎，每类诊断包含5个丰富假设，每类平衡采样1000文本。2. 比较五种解释方法：SHAP/LIME（模型无关）、occlusion/Input x Gradient（深度学习特定）、Attention x Gradient（Transformer特定）。3. 通过Top-token归因标准化解释，并使用Jaccard指数量化成对一致性。4. 进行定性错误审计以识别系统失败机制。

Result: 1. 在定义明确的临床领域达到高预测准确率，但在高语义歧义下性能下降。2. 解释稳定性直接反映预测确定性：在单一类别中收敛性强，在诊断不确定性下显著下降。3. 定性审计揭示三种系统性失败机制：词汇过度敏感、语义重叠和归因连贯性丧失。

Conclusion: 建议在审计基于Transformer的医疗文本分类模型时，结合多种解释方法和定量一致性指标；同时应优先使用特定的临床本体论而非广泛的诊断标签，以提高模型的可靠性和可解释性。

Abstract: A comparative explainability framework is presented to audit DeBERTa-v3 under zero-shot classification of medical abstracts. The work addresses the disagreement problem in Explainable Artificial Intelligence, where different attribution methods produce divergent explanations for the same input and prediction. A natural language inference engine is implemented over the Medical Abstracts corpus with five enriched hypotheses per diagnostic category and a balanced sample of one thousand texts per class. Five explanation methods are compared: SHAP and LIME as model-agnostic approaches, occlusion and Input x Gradient as deep-learning-specific approaches, and Attention x Gradient as a transformer-specific approach. Explanations are standardized through top-token attribution, and pairwise agreement is quantified using the Jaccard index. High predictive accuracy is achieved across well-defined clinical domains, whereas performance degrades under high semantic ambiguity. Explanatory stability directly mirrors predictive certainty, exhibiting strong convergence in univalent categories and a marked drop under diagnostic uncertainty. Furthermore, qualitative error auditing uncovers three systemic failure mechanisms: lexical hypersensitivity, semantic overlap, and loss of attribution coherence. The results support the combined use of several explanation methods and quantitative agreement metrics when auditing transformer-based models in medical text classification, and suggest prioritizing specific clinical ontologies over broad diagnostic labels.

</details>


### [435] [VISTA: A Visual Harness for Reasoning in an Interactive World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02200)
*Qiushi Han,Keya Hu,Linlu Qiu,Cathy Wu,Kaiming He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出VISTA，一种视觉工具（harness），通过提供长视距视觉和无损记忆，显著增强多模态模型在复杂视觉环境中的推理和任务解决能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示多模态模型潜在的强推理能力，并探索如何通过适当的“工具”解锁其在多样化交互环境中的应用潜力。

Method: 引入VISTA系统，使通用多模态模型能直接感知环境视觉信息，保持无损视觉记忆以保留历史观察，并允许模型主动检索和重组视觉输入进行推理。

Result: 在ARC-AGI-3基准测试中，VISTA将Claude Opus 5.0的相对人类行动效率得分从40.68提升至完美的100.00，完成任务所需动作比首次参与的人类少57.4%；在其他三个涵盖不同视觉游戏和谜题的基准测试中也大幅优于基线模型。

Conclusion: VISTA作为一种通用的视觉工具，具有简单的设计和良好的扩展性，能有效提升多模态智能体在复杂视觉环境中的表现，展示了巨大的应用潜力。

Abstract: We show that multimodal models possess strong reasoning abilities and that an appropriate harness can unlock their potential to solve tasks across diverse interactive environments. We introduce VISTA, a visual harness that gives a general-purpose multimodal model long-horizon vision. VISTA allows the model to directly perceive the environment through visual observations and maintains a lossless visual memory that preserves past observations in their original form. The model can actively retrieve these observations and reorganize its visual input as it reasons. On ARC-AGI-3, VISTA improves Claude Opus 5.0's Relative Human Action Efficiency score from 40.68 to a perfect 100.00, with the model completing all 25 public games using 57.4% fewer actions than first-time human participants. VISTA's simple design also allows it to extend naturally to diverse visual environments with minimal adaptation. Across three additional benchmarks covering a diverse range of visual games and puzzles, it substantially outperforms baselines using the same underlying model with minimal harnesses. Our results highlight VISTA's potential as a general-purpose visual harness for advancing multimodal agents in complex visual environments.

</details>


### [436] [A2Z GameSpec-Bench: How Faithfully Can Coding Agents Generate Games from Game Design Specifications?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39564)
*Seonho Lee,Wonryeol Jeong,Alberto Cereser,Inha Kang,Hyeonjong Kim,Seungmin Kwak,Dongmin Park*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出A2Z GameSpec-Bench基准，用于评估AI代理在长篇幅游戏设计文档（GDD）指导下的端到端游戏开发能力，强调对相互依赖需求的忠实度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准多使用紧凑规范，缺乏对长篇幅GDD中跨逻辑、渲染和交互的相互依赖需求的有效评估；需解决AI代理在完整开发中保持设计意图而非仅生成表面合理输出的问题。

Method: 构建包含100个长篇幅GDD的基准，将其转化为依赖感知合同（含规则、约束及前置关系）；结合源代码检查与代理生成的测试策略进行场景回放和自适应测试；通过固定合同和关联证据实现一致比较。

Result: 当前代理难以同时满足代码实现与实际游玩中的相互依赖需求；提供特定需求反馈后，经过两轮自我修订，GDD忠实度相对提升10.9%。

Conclusion: A2Z GameSpec-Bench超越了单纯的实现判断，评估了端到端的规范遵循能力，并通过针对性反馈支持更忠实的游戏开发，相关代码和数据集已开源。

Abstract: Delegating complete application development to coding agents requires preserving the intended design rather than simply producing plausible outputs through naive prompting. Game development provides a demanding testbed, as long-form Game Design Documents (GDDs) describe requirements that must work together across game logic, visual rendering, and player interactions. However, existing game-development benchmarks typically use compact specifications and provide limited support for evaluating interdependent requirements across these aspects in long-form GDDs. We introduce A2Z GameSpec-Bench, a benchmark of 100 long-form GDDs for evaluating end-to-end game development by agents. We measure faithfulness by checking whether the game satisfies the GDD requirements and preserves the relationships among them. Each GDD is turned into a dependency-aware contract that contains rules, constraints, and prerequisite relations. Following game-development practices, we combine source-code inspection with agent-generated test policies for scenario-based replay and adaptive playtesting. The contract remains fixed across agents and revision rounds, while judgments and evidence linked to the same requirements support consistent comparison and failure detection. Our evaluations show that current agents struggle to jointly satisfy interdependent requirements across code implementation and actual play. Requirement-specific feedback improves GDD Fidelity by 10.9% relative to self-revision after two rounds. A2Z GameSpec-Bench assesses end-to-end specification-following ability beyond implementation judgments and provides targeted feedback to support more faithful game development. Code and datasets are available at https://a2z-gamespec-bench.github.io.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [437] [Ask a Language Model for Lottery Numbers: Concentration in Repeated Six-of-49 Outputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00052)
*Dmitrij Żatuchin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 评估显示，大型语言模型在生成彩票数字时存在严重的分布集中现象，其多样性远低于理想随机抽样标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估不同语言模型配置在生成随机整数请求（模拟彩票场景）时的表现，特别是其输出结果的多样性和均匀性。

Method: 使用四种英语提示变体对六种语言模型配置进行了1,200次尝试调用，并对比了波兰实体彩票的历史样本数据。

Result: 模型生成的有效票据中，数字频率的有效多样性仅为9.9-18.0，远低于独立均匀抽样预期的46.6-46.7阈值；且高频模态票据占比高达22.5%-68.0%，显示出显著的集中趋势。

Conclusion: 在测试部署设置下，语言模型生成的随机数存在 substantial concentration（显著集中），但研究未阐明其机制，也未验证其他提示、温度或工具配置下的性能。

Abstract: We evaluate six language-model configurations on requests for six distinct random integers from 1-49. Across 1,200 attempted calls using four English prompt variants, 1,184 responses yielded valid tickets. Effective diversity of number frequencies ranged from 9.9 to 18.0, compared with simulated fifth-percentile thresholds of 46.6-46.7 under independent uniform six-of-49 sampling at the corresponding sample sizes. Systems produced 8-93 distinct unordered tickets, and their modal tickets accounted for 22.5-68.0% of valid responses. Two archived Polish Lotto samples provided a physical-lottery comparison, with effective diversities of 41.1 and 41.4 at smaller sample sizes. These results demonstrate substantial concentration under the tested deployment settings. They do not identify its mechanism or establish performance under other prompts, temperatures, or tool configurations.

</details>


### [438] [On-Device Commercial Intent Retrieval Under Size, Latency, and Privacy Constraints: A 3 MiB Retrieval System with Typed Egress Boundaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00170)
*Hyojung Han*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文在严格的端侧约束下（载荷<3MB、推理<20ms、数据不出设备），构建了一个基于4位量化静态嵌入表的韩语商业意图检索系统。主要发现是：在缺乏锚点（anchor）时，模型容量不足导致性能下降；通过对比微调可显著提升准确率；且可通过置信度评分过滤低置信样本以提升整体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究如何在完全离线、隐私保护且资源受限的端侧设备上实现高效的商业意图推断，以平衡隐私安全与模型性能。

Method: 1. 构建基于6,020个叶节点的静态嵌入表，源自韩语句子Transformer并量化为4位。
2. 使用22,900条AI-Hub购物评论进行真实韩语商业文本测试。
3. 分析约束条件对准确性的影响，对比纯编码器学生模型与大教师模型的差异。
4. 引入对比微调（contrastive pairs）优化学生模型。
5. 利用排名器自身分数边际检测高成本区域，并通过拒绝最低置信度的样本提升剩余样本性能。

Result: 1. 总体Top-5准确率为75.0%（基线18.4%）。
2. 查询包含叶子名称子串时准确率为83.5%，不包含时为45.2%。
3. 大教师模型在未加锚点时差距缩小20.1个百分点，但加入锚点后两者表现接近。
4. 对学生模型进行对比微调后，准确率提升10.6-20.9个百分点。
5. 拒绝最不自信的1/5样本后，其余样本准确率达到82.96%。
6. 实际推理延迟极低：iPhone A14/A16上约3.6-4.4ms，Android平板约5.1ms。

Conclusion: 在极端资源约束下，端侧商业意图推断是可行的，但受限于模型容量。通过对比微调和置信度过滤可有效弥补性能损失，同时满足隐私和实时性要求。

Abstract: We study commercial intent inference that runs entirely on the user's device, under three constraints frozen before the work began: the downloaded payload under 3 MiB, Tier-0 inference under 20 ms at p95, and no raw text, content embedding, or stable identifier leaving the device. Under them we build a retrieval path over a 6,020-leaf commercial taxonomy: a static embedding table distilled from a Korean sentence transformer, quantized to 4 bits, no inference runtime.
  Our main result is where that constraint costs accuracy. On real Korean commerce text labelled by others (22,900 AI-Hub shopping reviews), mid-category top-5 on real product names is 75.0% against an 18.4% permutation baseline, but splits on one observable: a query containing some leaf name as a substring scores 83.5%, one containing none 45.2%. A generic 196.6x larger teacher seemed to localize the gap (+20.1 pp without an anchor, +0.1 with). That null was two effects cancelling: the same teacher fine-tuned on the student's own contrastive pairs reaches 0.8586 and beats the pure-encoder student by +10.6 pp with an anchor and +20.9 pp without. The cost is not uniform, but it is not free anywhere; where the anchor is absent, task adaptation buys the teacher nothing, so what the constrained encoder lacks there is capacity. The expensive regime is detectable on-device from the ranker's own score margin: declining the least confident fifth lifts the rest to 0.8296.
  A second axis we first reported, a manufacturer model code, does not survive source-category fixed effects (-4.0 pp, p=0.51); the anchor does (+13.0 pp).
  Payload is 2,942,652 bytes, all three library links measured. Tier-0 p95 is 4.431 and 3.670 ms on two iPhones (A14, A16) and 5.080 ms on a budget Android tablet (Snapdragon 695), all slower than three server CPUs on the same code. Taxonomy supervision is mostly synthetic Korean utterances.

</details>


### [439] [System Attribution in LLM Brand Recommendations: Single Responses Identify the System, Aggregated Brand Profiles Do Not Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00253)
*Dmitrij Żatuchin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 研究测试AI审计生成的品牌推荐配置文件是否能准确描述特定语言模型系统。发现单条回复的表面形式（如字符n-gram）能极高准确率识别模型，但聚合后的行为配置文件在跨领域时失效，表明表面特征比聚合品牌行为更具系统特异性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估当前用于总结部署中语言模型品牌推荐的“AI可见性审计”方法的有效性，即测试生成的系统配置文件是否真正描述了该系统本身，而非其他因素。

Method: 收集来自五个部署端点的6,475个存储响应（涵盖礼品推荐、企业声誉和品类所有权查询），构建字符n-gram分类器进行交叉验证；同时分析长度、格式统计、品牌名称屏蔽等特征，并在不同域间进行聚合配置文件的迁移测试。

Result: 1. 仅用前800字符的n-gram分类器识别模型准确率达97.84%；2. 仅凭长度无法区分（降至多数类水平），但加入30项格式统计或屏蔽品牌名后准确率仍保持在95.79%-97.72%；3. 跨查询条件保持高准确率（加权97.43%），但在检索增强模块变化时Grok识别失败；4. 聚合为50个单元后，仅能以66.53%准确率分离四个系统；5. 跨域泛化失败：在礼品推荐域训练的模型将所有礼品单元错误归类，尽管单条回复识别平衡准确率为89.92%。

Conclusion: 答案的表面形式（surface form）足以跨越查询域识别系统，而聚合的品牌行为配置文件不能。当前的未交叉设计无法将系统特性与查询域或数据收集工具（harness）的影响分离开来，表明基于聚合配置的审计存在局限性。

Abstract: Audits of AI visibility summarise the brand recommendations of deployed language models into per-system profiles. We test whether such a profile describes the system on one corpus of 6,475 stored responses (6,324 analysable) collected between December 2025 and February 2026 from five deployed endpoints across gift-recommendation, corporate-reputation and category-ownership queries. The collection harness cut many answers short: 83.1% of Gemini 3 Flash answers in category ownership end mid-sentence under a 1,024-token output cap. With every answer cut to its first 800 characters, a character n-gram classifier cross-validated by prompt attributes one response to GPT-5.2, Gemini 3 Flash, Gemini 3 Flash with search, Grok or Perplexity sonar-pro with 97.84% accuracy (5,028 responses, 383 prompts, majority class 31.5%, 30 split seeds). Length alone falls to the majority rate, 24 formatting statistics reach 95.79%, and masking brand names and capitalised tokens leaves 97.72%. Held-out query conditions keep 97.43% weighted by size and 88.0% unweighted; in a retrieval-grounded arm that changes the harness, no Grok answer is attributed to Grok (0/120). Aggregated into 50 model-by-domain-by-condition units, twelve behavioural features separate four systems at 66.53% under grouped cross-validation, against a label-permutation null with mean 33.71% and 95th percentile 46.0%. Across domains the aggregate profile fails: a forest trained on category-ownership units assigns all 22 gift units to the wrong system, consistent with a reversal in brand volume (8.41 against 0.94 brands per response in gifts, 3.01 against 3.91 in category ownership), while single responses transfer at 89.92% balanced accuracy. The surface form of an answer carries the system across the query domains tested; aggregated brand behaviour does not, and the uncrossed design cannot separate the system from the domain or the harness.

</details>


### [440] [A Shared Taste for Model-Written Text: The Generator-by-Selector Matrices of "AI-AI Bias" Show No Detectable Own-Model Premium](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00369)
*Dmitrij Żatuchin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Laurito et al. (2025) 证实大语言模型普遍偏好其他模型生成的文本，但本研究通过重新分析发现，这种偏好并非源于模型对“自身”文本的特殊青睐（即无显著的 own-model 效应），而是由生成器和选择器的通用主效应驱动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验 Laurito et al. 的研究设计是否支持“选择器更偏好来自其自身模型的文本”这一隐含假设，并量化是否存在超越主效应的特定品牌/模型偏好。

Method: 重建 Laurito et al. 公开数据中的三个 5x5 矩阵（共 21,828 个有效试验），拟合包含“自身模型项（gamma）”的双向固定效应模型，并使用精确置换检验（针对 120 种选择器重标签）进行统计显著性测试，同时控制位置偏差。

Result: 在产品和论文摘要中，“自身模型”溢价不显著（p > 0.05）；电影数据边缘显著（p = 0.07）；汇总数据中 gamma = +0.019 (p = 0.14)。GPT-3.5 和 GPT-4 对的“同厂商”项在所有数据集中均为负值。研究具有足够的统计功效检测出 0.034 的 pooled 最小可检测效应，因此结果在约 0.04 的份额点以下具有信息量。相比之下，Tan et al. (2024) 的数据显示出显著的 gamma = +0.148。

Conclusion: Laurito et al. 的主要结论成立：模型确实共享对模型生成文本的偏好（例如 GPT-4 描述被所有选择器以 77%-95% 的概率选中）。然而，当前数据不支持“模型识别并偏爱自身文风”的假设，观察到的效应可由通用的模型间主效应解释。

Abstract: Laurito et al. (PNAS 2025) showed that large language models choosing between two descriptions of the same product, paper or film prefer the description written by a language model over the one written by a person, by a wide margin over what human judges do. Their design crosses five generators with the same five models as selectors, which permits a second question the paper does not headline: does a selector prefer text from its own model beyond what the generator and selector main effects predict? We rebuild the three 5x5 matrices from the per-item counts in the authors' public repository (21,828 valid trials; every cell matches the published value) and fit a two-way fixed-effects model with an own-model term gamma, tested by the exact permutation test over the 120 relabellings of the selectors. The premium is +0.013 on products (exact one-sided p = 0.24), -0.010 on paper abstracts (p = 0.74), +0.054 on films (p = 0.07) and +0.019 pooled (p = 0.14; 95% interval -0.008 to 0.046). The same-vendor term for the GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 pair is negative in all three datasets. Position bias moves single cells by up to 0.42 share points in either direction, and the own-model contrast is unchanged once order-driven items are removed. The design would have detected a premium of 0.05 with 82% (products), 88% (papers), 42% (films) and 97% (pooled) power; the minimum detectable effect at 80% power is 0.034 pooled. The absence is informative down to about 0.04 share points and silent below that. The 4x4 matrix of Tan et al. (ACL 2024) gives gamma = +0.148 at the smallest p its 24 relabellings allow, with a same-family term of the same size. The main result of Laurito et al. stands: models share a taste for model-written text, with GPT-4's descriptions chosen 77% to 95% of the time by every selector on products. What these data do not show is a model recognising and favouring its own prose.

</details>


### [441] [Comparison of Common Crawl News & GDELT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00587)
*Ameir El Ouadi,David Beskow*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文对比分析了GDELT和Common Crawl News两大全球新闻数据集，揭示了它们在数据来源（广播/印刷 vs 网络爬取）和内容覆盖上的显著差异及其优缺点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球新闻语料库对自然语言处理、知识图谱、大语言模型及实时理解世界互动至关重要，但现有数据集的使用需要更深入的评估。

Method: 对GDELT和Common Crawl News两个数据集的内容和覆盖范围进行对比分析，重点考察其数据收集机制（GDELT依赖全球广播、印刷和网络新闻；Common Crawl通过网页爬取聚焦新闻网站）。

Result: 研究发现两个数据集在新闻来源的获取方式上存在显著差异，并明确了各自的优势与局限性。

Conclusion: 深入理解不同新闻数据集的特性对于优化NLP、KG及LLM等任务的数据选择和应用具有重要意义。

Abstract: The corpus of worldwide news is important for natural language processing, knowledge graphs, large language models, and other technical efforts. Additionally, this corpus is important for understanding the people, places, organizations, and events that interact in real-time every day. This paper compares two news datasets used for these tasks today, namely the Global Database of Events, Language, and Tone (GDELT) and Common Crawl News. Our research highlights the strengths and limitations of each dataset, analyzing their content and coverage. Notably, while GDELT relies on broadcasts, prints, and web news from across the globe, Common Crawl focuses on news sites from around the world gathered through web crawling. Our analysis revealed considerable differences in where the two datasets gather their news sources.

</details>


### [442] [CANOPY: Adaptive-Granularity Evidence Compression for Multimodal RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00923)
*Hyojeong Yun,Jueun Kim,Wook-Shin Han*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出CANOPY框架，通过层级结构和节点评分实现自适应粒度证据压缩，并结合批评者机制进行针对性补充检索，在保持准确率的同时显著减少输入token数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态RAG中，单一检索粒度难以平衡上下文保留与无关内容剔除的问题；现有方法缺乏跨异构项的共享自适应压缩机制。

Method: 1. 将检索项表示为层级结构，使用微调节点编码器对区域进行查询相关性评分；2. 通过父级相对细化（Parent-relative refinement）在不同粒度下选择多个关键区域，无需LLM调用即可进行节点剪枝；3. 引入批评者（Critic）机制，当累积证据不足时请求针对性后续检索，并对新检索项进行压缩后再合并。

Result: 在3300万条异构语料库的五个QA基准测试中，CANOPY的平均答案准确率高于现有检索基线；消融实验表明额外检索是多跳QA性能提升的主因；在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct模型中，相比无压缩迭代流程，证据token减少14.2%-27.7%且保持相当准确率。

Conclusion: CANOPY通过自适应粒度压缩和动态补充检索，有效解决了多模态RAG中上下文冗余与缺失的权衡问题，提升了效率与准确性。

Abstract: Multimodal RAG retrieves text, tables, images, and videos, but choosing a retrieval granularity does not determine how much context to retain within each item. Coarse units include irrelevant content, while uniformly fine selection can remove context needed to interpret the evidence. Existing compressors address this trade-off with modality-specific mechanisms, leaving open a shared procedure for adapting the retained extent region by region across heterogeneous items. We introduce CANOPY (Canonical Projection over Hierarchy), a framework for adaptive-granularity post-retrieval evidence compression. CANOPY represents retrieved items as hierarchies and uses a node encoder fine-tuned on gold evidence to score regions against the query. Parent-relative refinement compares these scores to select multiple regions at different granularities without LLM calls for node-level pruning. Because compression cannot recover evidence that was never retrieved, a critic requests targeted follow-up retrieval when it judges the accumulated evidence insufficient; newly retrieved items are compressed before being added. Across five QA benchmarks over a 33M-item heterogeneous corpus, CANOPY achieves higher average answer accuracy than the evaluated retrieval baselines. Ablations indicate that additional retrieval drives the main accuracy gains on multi-hop QA. In the unrouted Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct setting, compression reduces reader-input evidence tokens by 14.2-27.7% relative to the same iterative pipeline without compression, with comparable answer accuracy.

</details>


### [443] [RPTune: Learned Context Curation for LLM Catalog Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00964)
*Chuxuan Hu,Hejie Cui,Norman Huang,Shubham Kumar Bharti,Wang-Chiew Tan,Sercan Ö. Arık*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出RPTune框架，通过编码器重排器优化目录并微调LLM，显著提升小商户基于长上下文的搜索准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对小商户（SMBs），全目录提示是替代多阶段检索的有效方案，但现有LLM无法均匀利用长上下文，导致直接输入目录效果不佳。需解决如何策展目录及如何适配LLM以有效利用这些上下文的问题。

Method: 提出RPTune端到端框架，结合自动生成的目录监督信号进行LLM后训练。使用编码器-重排器策展人根据下游LLM反馈对商品进行排序和剪枝；利用上下文相关奖励优化LLM后训练，使策展后的目录提升模型性能。

Result: 在7个真实商户的100个复杂对话查询上评估，RPTune在专有和开源LLM上均持续提高搜索准确率。仅上下文策展即可带来高达31.4个百分点的提升，后训练平均额外增加10.3个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过联合学习目录策展与LLM后训练，能有效克服LLM在长上下文中的利用缺陷，为小商户提供更高效的目录搜索解决方案。

Abstract: For small merchant businesses (SMBs) whose catalogs fit within a long-context LLM, full-catalog prompting offers a compelling alternative to multi-stage retrieval designed primarily for large marketplaces with millions of items. However, fitting the full catalog into the context window does not ensure that the model can use it effectively, since LLMs do not exploit long contexts uniformly. We therefore study in-context catalog search through two complementary questions: (1) how to curate and present catalogs to the LLM, and (2) how to adapt the LLM for product selection on curated contexts.
  We propose RPTune, an end-to-end framework that couples learned catalog curation with LLM post-training using automatically generated, catalog-grounded supervision. An encoder-reorganizer curator orders and prunes products guided by downstream LLM feedback, while the resulting curated catalogs in turn improve the effectiveness of LLM post-training with a context-relative reward. We evaluate RPTune on 7 real merchants spanning distinct retail verticals, using 100 complex conversational queries per merchant.
