RPTune consistently improves search accuracy across both proprietary and open-weight LLMs, with context curation yielding gains of up to 31.4 percentage points and post-training adding a further 10.3 points on average.

</details>


### [444] [Do Multilingual Encoders Produce Language-Consistent Semantic IDs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01139)
*Abhinav Bohra,Anuj Bohra*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 研究发现，仅依靠多语言编码器或平衡量化器拟合无法保证跨语言产品获得一致性的语义ID（SIDs）。翻译导致的嵌入位移会显著降低SID的一致性，且这种影响并非由量化器选择性放大语言方向引起。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在生成式检索中，使用多语言编码器是否足以让同一产品的不同语言版本获得语言一致的语义ID（SIDs），以及量化过程对翻译引起的嵌入变化是否敏感。

Method: 使用Amazon ESCI列表（英、西、日三种语言），测试翻译与源文本的接近程度；评估残差量化对翻译位移的敏感性；对比多语言编码器和语言平衡量化器拟合对SID一致性的影响。

Result: 1. 多语言E5模型使翻译结果在嵌入空间中明显偏离源文本：在英语主导拟合下，日语翻译保留英文对应项首个SID代码的比例仅为7.7%，而英语改写为89.0%。2. 距离匹配的产品定向控制实验显示，翻译造成的SID不匹配程度与非语言因素相当，证明量化器并未选择性放大语言方向。3. 平衡拟合 mixture 虽使码本使用更均匀，但进一步降低了跨语言前缀一致性（如西班牙语从28.3%降至6.6%），而英语单一拟合则保留了更高的西班牙语文本一致性（67.6%）。

Conclusion: 多语言曝光和平衡的码本使用本身并不能保证语义ID的语言一致性。跨语言检索中，翻译引起的嵌入空间位移是SID不一致的主要来源，需关注嵌入对齐而非仅依赖量化策略优化。

Abstract: Semantic IDs (SIDs) compress item embeddings into discrete code sequences used in generative retrieval. We ask whether a multilingual encoder is sufficient for different-language renderings of the same product to receive language-consistent SIDs. Using Amazon ESCI listings rendered in English, Spanish, and Japanese, we test whether translations remain close to their English source, whether residual quantization is unusually sensitive to translation-induced movement, and whether multilingual or language-balanced quantizer fitting improves SID agreement. Multilingual E5 places translations measurably apart: under an English-heavy fit, a Japanese translation preserves the first SID code of its English counterpart in only 7.7% of cases, compared with 89.0% for an English rewording. Distance-matched product-directed controls produce nearly the same full-SID mismatch as translation, providing no evidence that the quantizer selectively amplifies language directions. Balancing the fitting mixture makes codebook use more uniform but further reduces cross-lingual prefix agreement: Spanish first-code consistency falls from 28.3% to 6.6%, while an English-only fit preserves it for 67.6% of Spanish translations. These results show that multilingual exposure and balanced codebook use alone do not guarantee language-consistent SIDs.

</details>


### [445] [Learning to structure data from user-generated thematic corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01463)
*Elishay Avram,Oren Glickman,Elad Yom-Tov*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动化迭代框架，无需预定义本体即可从非结构化文本中自动发现、提取领域特定属性模式并填充数据。在5个健康类Reddit社区评估中，发现属性与人工标注一致性达61%，结构类型分配准确率达82%，值提取F1分数为0.8。该框架支持使用较小规模的指令微调模型进行高效、低成本的价值提取，证明了自动发现人类可比属性的可行性及规模化挖掘主题语料库的经济性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体等主题语料库包含大量未结构化文本，其中蕴含的个人属性、行为和经验等数据具有潜在的结构化价值。然而，由于相关属性通常隐含、依赖领域且预先未知，从中提取结构化数据面临巨大挑战。现有方法往往需要预定义的本体或复杂的规则，缺乏灵活性和可扩展性。

Method: 构建一个完全自动化的迭代框架：1) 利用大型语言模型（LLMs）诱导候选属性；2) 顺序合并语义重叠的属性；3) 为属性分配结构类型，从而创建本体并从语料库中填充值。该框架还允许使用较小的LLMs进行值提取，以估算的精度损失换取成本效益。

Result: 1) 在5个健康相关的Reddit社区上验证了框架有效性；2) 发现的属性与人工识别属性的一致性达到61%（接近独立标注员间的62%一致性）；3) 算法通常在少于10次迭代后收敛到稳定的属性集；4) 结构类型分配准确率为82%；5) 值提取达到0.8的F1分数；6) 跨四种LLM家族测试显示，较小指令微调模型随规模增大在提取性能上呈现统计显著改进，支持精度-成本的权衡决策。

Conclusion: 该研究证明，通过迭代模型驱动的 schema 诱导，可以自动发现与人工识别相当的高质量属性，无需预定义本体。这为经济、大规模地从主题语料库中挖掘结构化数据提供了实用且可扩展的基础，解决了非结构化文本中提取隐含领域特定属性的难题。

Abstract: Thematic corpora, such as social media communities, contain unstructured text describing data that could be made structured. These include, for example, personal attributes, behaviors, and experiences mentioned in social media data. Extracting structured data is challenging as relevant attributes are often implicit, domain-dependent, and unknown in advance. We propose a fully automated, iterative framework for discovering and extracting domain-specific attribute schemas without a predefined ontology. Using large language models (LLMs), the framework induces candidate attributes, sequentially consolidates semantically overlapping attributes, and assigns a structural type. These enable creating an ontology and populating it with values from the corpus. The framework also enables the use of smaller LLMs for value extraction with estimable accuracy loss compared to large LLMs. We evaluate the framework on 5 health-related Reddit communities. Discovered attributes achieved 61% agreement with human-identified attributes, close to the 62% agreement between independent annotators. In most cases, the algorithm converges to a stable attribute set in fewer than 10 iterations. Structural type assignment achieves 82% accuracy, and value extraction reaches an F1 score of 0.8 compared to human annotations. Across four LLM families, smaller instruction-tuned models show statistically significant improvements in extraction performance with model scale when evaluated against a high-capacity reference LLM, supporting informed accuracy-cost trade-offs. These results show that attributes comparable to those identified by humans can be discovered automatically, enabling the creation of high-quality structured datasets economically and at scale. By removing the need for predefined ontologies, iterative model-driven schema induction offers a practical and scalable foundation for mining thematic corpora.

</details>


### [446] [From Rules to Neural Graphs: Scalable Structured Prediction for Patent Prior Art Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01553)
*Nikolai Zenovkin,Sebastian Björkqvist*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于双仿射注意力（biaffine attention）的神经解析器，用于直接从专利文本构建结构化发明图。该方法通过局部注意力机制降低计算复杂度，实现了长文档处理且无需重新训练，在下游检索任务中提升了引用召回率并降低了推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的神经检索方法通常因输入截断而受限，无法有效处理包含数万token的长专利文档；而传统的基于图的检索方法虽然能保留结构信息，但其依赖的规则解析器构建过程脆弱且不稳定。

Method: 1. 借鉴依存句法分析中的双仿射注意力机制，直接预测专利文本对应的发明图。
2. 引入局部双仿射注意力，将成对评分限制在滑动窗口内，将时间复杂度从 $O(n^2)$ 降低至 $O(n \cdot w)$。
3. 利用局部与全局评分共享权重的特性，使模型在短序列上训练即可部署到超过40,000 token的长文档中，无需重训。
4. 使用100万份规则解析文档进行知识蒸馏训练该神经解析器。

Result: 1. 推理成本仅为教师模型（规则解析器）的1/3。
2. 在下游Graph Transformer检索系统中，相比基线方法：短查询场景下引用召回率提升0.5%，完整文档场景下提升1.1%。

Conclusion: 该神经解析器成功解决了长专利文档的结构化表示难题，通过高效注意力机制和知识蒸馏技术，在保证高性能的同时显著降低了计算开销，优于传统的规则解析方法。

Abstract: Patent search requires processing documents routinely exceeding tens of thousands of tokens. Most neural retrieval approaches operate on truncated inputs, limiting their effectiveness. Graph-based retrieval addresses this by representing each patent as a structured invention graph, but constructing these graphs relies on brittle rule-based parsers. We present the neural parser, which adapts biaffine attention from dependency parsing to predict invention graphs directly from patent text. Our local biaffine attention restricts pairwise scoring to a sliding window, reducing complexity from $O(n^2)$ to $O(n \cdot w)$. Since local and global scoring share the same weights, the model trains on short sequences and deploys on documents exceeding 40,000 tokens without retraining. Distilled from 1 million rule-parsed documents, it surpasses its teacher at 3$\times$ lower inference cost: neural graphs improve citation recall by 0.5% on short queries and 1.1% on full documents in a downstream Graph Transformer retrieval system.

</details>


### [447] [AgentWebRec: Compact Evidence Fusion over the Agent Web for Personalized Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01705)
*Haoran Qiang,Guannan Liu,Liang Zhang,Junjie Wu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出AgentWebRec框架，解决大模型智能体网络中推荐证据分散、异构且隐私受限的问题。通过任务级证据获取与融合策略，在有限预算下动态查询并融合用户智能体的本地私有记忆及邻居智能体的互补偏好，实现优于基线的推荐效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着基于LLM的个人智能体成为用户语义的持久载体，传统的“用户-平台”关系演变为“用户-智能体网-平台”路径。然而，该新路径导致推荐证据分散在相互不透明的智能体中，仅能通过有限查询访问，相关证据占比小，且不同智能体返回的响应语义异构，难以直接应用传统基于聚合数据的推荐方法。

Method: 提出AgentWebRec框架，将推荐重构为有限证据预算下的“任务级证据获取与融合”问题。该方法包括：1）以平台提供的物品语义为基础；2）从目标用户智能体的私有记忆中获取任务相关证据；3）当本地证据不足时，条件性地查询相邻用户智能体以获取互补的偏好模式；4）逐步获取并融合分布式证据，同时保持底层智能体记忆的本地化。

Result: 在四个InstructRec数据集上的实验表明，AgentWebRec consistently（一致地）优于基线推荐器。消融实验验证了证据层贡献了互补性的增益。

Conclusion: AgentWebRec有效解决了智能体网络中分布式、异构且局部化的用户知识在推荐中的应用难题，证明了任务级证据获取与融合策略在处理稀疏和异构智能体数据方面的有效性。

Abstract: LLM-based personal agents are emerging as persistent carriers of user semantics and intermediaries between users and recommendation platforms, maintaining richer user knowledge locally. As agents interact with one another, the conventional \textit{User--Platform} relation evolves into a \textit{User--Agent Web--Platform} information pathway, enabling distributed user-side information to complement item-side information. This new pathway, however, defies conventional recommendation: evidence is scattered across mutually opaque agents and reachable only through bounded queries, only a small portion of it is relevant to the current recommendation decision, and the responses returned by different agents are semantically heterogeneous. We therefore recast recommendation over the agent web as a \emph{task-time evidence acquisition and fusion} problem under a finite evidence budget by deciding what to ask and what to keep, rather than learning from aggregated data. We propose AgentWebRec, a user-agent-oriented framework that progressively acquires and fuses distributed evidence for each user-item decision while keeping underlying agent memories local. It grounds each decision in platform-provided item semantics and task-relevant evidence from the target user agent's private memory, and conditionally queries neighboring user agents for complementary preference patterns when local evidence is insufficient. Experiments on four InstructRec datasets show that AgentWebRec consistently outperforms baseline recommenders, and ablations verify that the evidence layers contribute complementary gains.

</details>


### [448] [Optimizing Effective Training Time for Large-Scale Recommendation Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02057)
*Mingming Ding,Ruilin Chen,Yuzhen Huang,Hang Qi,Menglu Yu,San Tan,Damian Reeves,Boris Sarana,Kevin Tang,Satendra Gera,Gagan Jain,Sahil Shah,Vishwa Karia,Fuzail Khan,Yashasvi Makin,Edward Z. Yang,Oguz Ulgen,Jia Chen Ren,Laith Sakka,Mayank Garg,Meet Vadakkanchery,Aici Lin,Wei Sun,Mengjiao Zhou,Shuai Yang,Junqing Zhou,Max Leung,Apoorv Purwar,Musharaf Sultan,John Bocharov,Zhenyu Tang,Vivek Trehan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 针对大规模推荐训练集群中生命周期开销导致加速器容量被静默消耗的问题，本文提出基于有效训练时间（ETT%）的分析框架及一系列全栈优化措施。通过消除通信、重叠流水线、动态形状处理、异步检查点等技术，显著提升了训练效率，使最大工作负载的ETT%从50-60%提升至85%，集群整体从约80%提升至90%以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大规模推荐训练集群中，生命周期开销（如初始化、恢复、检查点等）严重浪费了加速器容量。尽管每天处理数百亿训练样本，但此前仅有50-60%的端到端墙钟时间用于实际的新数据训练，其余时间被非计算性开销占用，亟需系统性分析与优化以提升资源利用率。

Method: 1. 提出有效训练时间百分比（ETT%）作为操作框架，用于量化丢失的时间并定位到具体的基础设施组件。
2. 实施涵盖整个训练栈的优化措施，包括：训练器初始化期间的通信消除与流水线重叠、动态形状处理、自动调优剪枝、可复用的PyTorch 2编译缓存、异步检查点、独立模型发布以及降低恢复成本。
3. 在代表性模型和实际训练集群中进行评估验证。

Result: 1. 所有基准测试的ETT%均得到改善，平均提升15.5%。
2. 最大工作负载的ETT%达到85%。
3. 部署后，集群范围的ETT%从约80%提升至90%以上。

Conclusion: 通过系统性地分析和优化推荐训练集群中的生命周期开销，可以显著提高有效训练时间比例，从而更充分地利用昂贵的加速器资源，实现更高效的大规模机器学习训练。

Abstract: Lifecycle overhead silently consumes accelerator capacity across large-scale recommendation training fleets. Our largest recommendation workloads process tens of billions train- ing examples per day on thousands of GPUs. Before this work, only 50-60% of their end-to-end wall time advanced training on new data. We present a fleet-scale study of this lifecycle overhead and a set of optimizations spanning the full training stack. We use Effective Training Time (ETT%) as an operational framework to instrument lost time, localize it to independently owned infrastructure components, and expose work repeated across job restarts. This analysis guides optimizations like communication elimination and pipeline overlap during trainer initialization; dynamic-shape handling, autotuning pruning, and reusable Py- Torch 2 compilation caches; asynchronous checkpointing; stan- dalone model publishing; and reductions in recovery cost. We evaluate the optimizations on representative models and measure their impacts in our training fleet. ETT% improves on every benchmark, by 15.5% on average, and reaches 85% on our largest workload. Fleet-wide ETT% rose from about 80% to above 90% after deployment.

</details>


<div id='cs.DB'></div>

# cs.DB [[Back]](#toc)

### [449] [Guarded Commits: Transactional Human Approvals for LLM Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00037)
*Laurent Bindschaedler,Ferdi Kossmann,Chunwei Liu,Jason Mohoney*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 提出一种“受保护提交”（guarded-commit）设计，将人类审批作为工作流状态的一部分，通过在外部执行前记录决议和证据到分类账中，确保每个风险路径都经过审批检查，支持审计和重放。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM工作流通常将人类审批置于工作流之外（如界面点击或审计条目），导致缺乏在提交时检查所有风险路径是否达到审批门控的机制；日志可能未保留审查证据或重用先前决策的条件。

Method: 1. 在外部动作运行前，决策源将决议记录及其引用的证据追加到分类账（ledger）。2. 使用凭据受限的提交适配器（credential-confined commit adapter）将记录与工件、策略版本和执行路径进行比对验证。3. 通过合成无环工作流计划的验证器测试注入故障（缺失门控、错误门控类型、不完整路径覆盖）进行测试。4. 在三个公开工作负载（共271,035条轨迹）上进行重放实验。

Result: 1. 验证器测试成功接受无故障计划，并拒绝包含每种注入故障的计划。2. 在公开工作负载重放中，当存在记录时能复现工件哈希值。3. 避免的审查次数及与记录决策的分歧程度因工作负载而异。4. 生成的记录支持在决议记录时的现行策略下进行审计和重放。

Conclusion: 该设计通过将人类审批嵌入工作流状态并提供可验证的证据链，有效解决了现有系统在审批追踪和合规性方面的不足，为LLM工作流提供了更强的安全性和审计能力。

Abstract: LLM workflows often require human approval before an irreversible external action. Most systems keep that approval outside the workflow, as an interface click or an audit entry. The workflow therefore lacks a commit-time check that every risky path reached an approval gate. Its logs may not preserve the reviewed evidence or the conditions for reusing an earlier decision. We present a guarded-commit design that makes human approval part of workflow state. Before the external action runs, a decision source appends a resolution record and its referenced evidence to a ledger. A credential-confined commit adapter then checks that record against the artifact, policy version, and executed path. Our evidence is limited to trace reconstruction. A validator test on synthetic acyclic workflow plans accepts unfaulted plans and rejects plans with each injected fault: a missing gate, the wrong gate type, or incomplete path coverage. Across three public workloads totaling 271,035 traces, replay reproduces recorded artifact hashes when present. Avoided reviews and disagreement with recorded decisions vary by workload. The resulting record supports audit and replay under the policy in force when the resolution was recorded.

</details>


### [450] [BuildGraph: A Synthetic Multi-Archetype Building Knowledge Graph Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00038)
*Wooyoung Jung*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: BuildGraph是一个包含120栋建筑的合成建筑知识图谱数据集，旨在解决真实建筑KG数据稀缺的问题。它基于Brick Schema和DOE原型模型构建，具有高度的结构完整性和现实传感器分布特征，为设施管理者和数字孪生开发者提供了开放测试平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管语义查询是人工智能集成到建筑运营中的基础，但由于专有性、安全性和成本障碍，真实的建筑知识图谱（KGs）很少公开可用，导致缺乏标准化的测试基准和数据资源。

Method: 构建了包含8种商业建筑类型、3个ASHRAE能源代码年代、每类5种变体（共120栋建筑）的合成数据集。利用U.S. Department of Energy原型模型和真实建筑的传感器放置模式进行生成，并通过75个SPARQL查询基准验证其结构完整性，同时分析其与真实建筑传感器类型比例的相似度。此外，进行了Gemma 4 (26B)模型的文本到SPARQL下游实验。

Result: 1. 结构完整性：BuildGraph的查询回答率为91.5%，远高于真实Brick文件的35.8%。
2. 现实性证据：与真实建筑共享词汇的传感器类型比例余弦相似度达到0.86-0.94。
3. 性能提升：在12栋未见过的建筑上，Gemma 4模型实现27.3%的行匹配F1分数，比零样本基线提升17.5个百分点。
4. 资源开放：数据集、生成器和基准已开源。

Conclusion: BuildGraph通过提供高完整性、高现实性的合成建筑KG数据，填补了该领域公共数据的空白，有效支持了便携式分析和自然语言接口的开发与研究，具有重要的实用价值和开源贡献。

Abstract: Semantic querying of building knowledge graphs (KGs) underpins the integration of artificial intelligence into building operations, from natural-language access to cross-building analytics, but such KGs are rarely public owing to proprietary, security, and cost barriers. BuildGraph is a synthetic building KG dataset of 120 buildings in the Brick Schema ontology, grounded in U.S. Department of Energy prototype models and sensor-placement patterns from real buildings. It spans eight commercial building types across three ASHRAE energy-code vintages, with five realizations per archetype varying URI naming, sensor-attachment predicates, and topology. A 75-query SPARQL benchmark confirms structural completeness: BuildGraph reaches 91.5% Query Answerability Rate versus 35.8% for 59 real-world Brick files. Independently, it reproduces real buildings' sensor-type proportions on their shared vocabulary (cosine 0.86-0.94), evidence of realistic instrumentation where measurable. A downstream text-to-SPARQL experiment with Gemma 4 (26B) reaches 27.3% Row-Matching F1 (+17.5 pp over zero-shot) on 12 held-out buildings. BuildGraph gives facility managers and digital-twin developers a testbed for portable analytics and natural-language interfaces, and its dataset, generator, and benchmark are openly available at https://github.com/humanbuildingsynergy/BuildGraph.

</details>


### [451] [Zengram-Lite: An In-Browser Agentic-Memory Framework - Semantic Knowledge, Session Tracking, and Token-Budgeted Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00042)
*Gene Zhang*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: zengram-lite 是一个运行在浏览器中的轻量级 AI 代理记忆框架，通过 WebAssembly 实现，提供包含事实生命周期、会话追踪和上下文组装的三层事务性存储，解决了当前客户端状态管理缺乏结构化记忆的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有浏览器端 AI 代理的状态管理主要依赖向量索引和简单的 localStorage 数组，缺乏对事实置信度、来源、会话关联及上下文管理的统一抽象，导致记忆碎片化且难以维护一致性。

Method: 开发一个编译为 ~2.95 MB 压缩 WebAssembly 文件的 zengram-lite 框架，基于 zeta-lite SQL 引擎构建，提供三个层级的服务：知识层（混合检索与事实生命周期管理）、会话追踪层（将对话作为可查询的一等公民数据）和上下文组装层（在令牌预算内生成提示并返回指纹以支持复用），并利用 MVCC 快照隔离和写时复制数据库分支保证事务一致性。

Result: 该框架成功在单个浏览器标签页中实现了完整的代理记忆功能，支持混合向量与全文检索、动态调整的事实置信度、时间衰减的重要性评分以及结构化的会话历史管理，并通过异步 LLM 结果的“自带结果”接口实现与 JavaScript 应用的无缝集成。

Conclusion: zengram-lite 为浏览器端 AI 代理提供了一种标准化、事务一致且高效的记忆解决方案，通过结构化数据和细粒度的上下文控制，显著提升了代理记忆的可靠性、可查询性和资源利用率。

Abstract: AI agents increasingly run in the browser, and they need somewhere to keep what they learn. The client-side state of the art, however, is a vector index - nearest-neighbor search over embeddings - with the rest of an agent's memory left to application code: the conversation history is an array in localStorage, context management is hand-rolled truncation, and there is no shared notion of a fact's confidence, its provenance, or the session that produced it. We present zengram-lite, an agentic-memory framework compiled to a single ~2.95 MB gzipped WebAssembly artifact that runs entirely in a browser tab. It provides three tiers over one transactional store. The knowledge tier offers hybrid vector-and-full-text recall with a fact lifecycle - confidence that rises and falls as facts are confirmed or contradicted, importance that decays over time, supersession that treats a restated fact as an update, and scope namespacing. The session-tracking tier models the conversation itself as first-class data: sessions, turns, typed content parts, and tool calls with state and timing, all as queryable tables. The context-assembly tier turns that structure into a token-budgeted prompt through a six-phase assembly that packs system instructions, knowledge, and recent history under a caller's budget, and returns a stable fingerprint that signals when a prompt prefix can be reused. The bundle is a superset of the zeta-lite SQL engine - the same .wasm re-exports the full Postgres-compatible surface, MVCC snapshot isolation, and copy-on-write database branching - so memory inherits transactional consistency across all three tiers. Because the wasm surface is synchronous while the framework's canonical operations depend on an asynchronous LLM and embedder, zengram-lite exposes a bring-your-own-result seam that runs the framework's real code paths over results the application computes in JavaScript.

</details>


### [452] [On Enforcing Database Constraints Using MS VBA Event Driven Procedures and SQL Server](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00633)
*Diana Christina Mancas*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于MS VBA事件驱动过程的数据库约束强制执行方法，提供伪代码算法辅助开发，并通过家谱软件实例验证其有效性。该方法能确保数据质量，且具备跨RDBMS和NoSQL平台的兼容性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在“数据库约束驱动设计与开发”软件工程框架下，为解决构建于MS SQL Server之上的软件应用中严格强制执行数据库约束（包括关系型及非关系型约束）的需求，以保障数据管理的高质量。

Method: 1. 利用MS VBA事件驱动过程来实施数据库约束；2. 设计并提供一种辅助开发者执行此过程的伪代码算法；3. 在家谱数据库软件应用中通过具体的VBA代码示例对该方法进行实证分析。

Result: 1. 该方法能够强制执行管辖该业务领域的所有数据库约束，从而保证所管理数据的最高可能质量；2. 提出的算法不仅适用于其他关系型数据库管理系统，也能兼容NoSQL平台后端；3. 适配其他类似SQL嵌入前端平台所需的修改极小。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了一种严谨的方法论和实用工具（伪代码算法），有效解决了特定架构下的数据完整性问题，并证明了其良好的通用性和可扩展性。

Abstract: The goal of this paper is to provide a rigorous methodology for enforcing database constraints using MS VBA event-driven procedures for software applications built on top of MS SQL Server databases, in the framework of the software engineering Database Constraint-Driven Design and Development. The original contribution is a pseudo-code algorithm for assisting developers in this process. We exemplify the results of using it with some VBA code examples taken from a genealogy database software application designed and developed using this methodology. Consequently, it enforces all the database constraints -be they relational or not- which govern this sub-universe of discourse, thus guaranteeing the highest possible quality of its managed data. We also show that the proposed algorithm works fine not only for other relational database management systems, but even with NoSQL platform backends, and that the modifications needed to adapt it to other similar SQL embedding frontend platforms are minimal.

</details>


### [453] [TabJoinBench: A Benchmark for Joinable Table Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00817)
*Sandipan De,Jin Wang,Vivek Gupta*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 提出TabJoinBench基准，用于在语义、关系和混合数据湖场景中公平评估连接发现方法，解决现有研究因基准构建方式不同导致难以复现和比较的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的连接发现方法依赖特定方法的基准构建，导致结果难以复现且无法进行公平比较。

Method: 构建TabJoinBench基准，使用源特定的验证策略生成查询-候选对，通过可组合的扰动系统地引入结构、表示和语义变化，同时保留可靠的真实标签；评估了基于集合、基于特征和基于学习的方法以及通用语言模型嵌入基线。

Result: 公开了处理后的数据集、真实标签注释和生成管道，为可复现评估和未来研究提供了支持。

Conclusion: TabJoinBench促进了连接发现方法的标准化评估和可复现性研究。

Abstract: Join discovery aims to identify tables from large data repositories that can augment a query table with complementary information, enabling downstream tasks such as data exploration, feature engineering, and business intelligence. Although numerous join discovery methods have been proposed, existing studies rely on method-specific benchmark construction, making reproducible and fair comparison difficult. We present TabJoinBench, a benchmark for evaluating join discovery methods across semantic, relational, and hybrid data lake scenarios. TabJoinBench constructs query-candidate pairs using source-specific validation strategies, systematically introduces structural, representation, and semantic changes through composable perturbations while preserving reliable ground truth. We evaluate representative join discovery methods spanning set-based, feature-based, and learned approaches, together with general-purpose language-model embedding baselines, and publicly release the processed datasets, ground-truth annotations, and generation pipeline to facilitate reproducible evaluation and future research.

</details>


### [454] [HakiCC: LLM-Driven Multi-Agent Design and Optimization of Concurrency Control Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00889)
*Farzad Habibi,Juncheng Fang,Faisal Nawab*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 提出HakiCC，一种基于LLM的多智能体流水线，自动为特定应用设计、验证并优化并发控制协议，显著提升吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管存在丰富的并发控制（CC）协议，但实践中多默认使用2PL或OCC，因为定制协议需要稀缺的专业知识。这种通用基线未能发挥针对特定应用的性能优势，造成资源浪费。

Method: 构建HakiCC双阶段流水线：阶段1利用多智能体系统根据工作负载描述生成CC协议实现，并通过迭代修复确保冲突可串行化；阶段2通过LLM驱动的进化循环，在保持正确性的同时优化吞吐量。

Result: 在TPC-C和AuctionMark基准测试中成功生成10个应用特定CC协议。所有协议经阶段1后均满足冲突可串行性；阶段2使所有协议吞吐量提升，平均增益分别为TPC-C的+50.6%和AuctionMark的+92.2%。

Conclusion: HakiCC证明了LLM驱动的多智能体方法能有效自动化高性能并发控制协议的设计与优化，解决了专家知识匮乏问题，并为应用提供了显著的性能改进。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently been applied in systems research as a tool to reduce human-intensive engineering effort through cost-efficient automation. Decades of research have produced a rich landscape of concurrency control (CC) protocols, each encoding distinct trade-offs in correctness, throughput, and abort behavior. However, most applications in practice default to 2PL or OCC, because selecting and adapting a protocol to a specific application requires expert knowledge that is rarely available to application designers. This is a wasted opportunity, as an application-specific CC protocol can yield significant performance advantages over a generic baseline, but designing one requires deep expertise in CC protocol design.
  In this paper, we propose HakiCC, an LLM-driven multi-agent pipeline that automatically designs, verifies, and optimizes concurrency control protocols tailored to a given target application. HakiCC provides a two-stage pipeline. In Stage 1, a multi-agent system takes a workload description as input and generates an application-specific CC protocol implementation, which is iteratively repaired and verified for conflict-serializability. In Stage 2, the verified protocol is further optimized for that application through an LLM-driven evolutionary loop targeting correctness and throughput. We evaluate HakiCC on TPC-C and AuctionMark as target workloads, producing and reporting ten application-specific CC protocols. All ten are conflict-serializable after Stage 1; Stage 2 improves throughput for every protocol, with average gains of +50.6% for TPC-C protocols and +92.2% for AuctionMark protocols.

</details>


### [455] [STEER: Reducing Inference Cost in Relational Foundation Models through Semantically Informed Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00907)
*Abdalla Mohamed,Ashraf Aboulnaga*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 提出STEER方法，通过LLM对数据库模式中的外键进行相关性排序，动态缩小关系基础模型（RFMs）的推理上下文，在减少约40%上下文大小的同时保持或提升预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 降低关系基础模型（RFMs）的推理成本至关重要，因为当前基于随机采样邻居行的方法会导致上下文随数据规模增长，而简单的行丢弃策略忽略了数据库模式的语义，可能误删关键信息。

Method: 提出STEER采样方法：首先利用大语言模型（LLM）仅根据数据库模式将外键边按与任务的相关性分为不同层级；然后将每个层级映射为遍历时的概率；最后基于此概率分布采样相关表以构建紧凑的推理上下文。由于仅依赖模式，该排名计算一次即可复用。

Result: 在RT、RT-J和Griffin三种最先进的RFMs上评估，STEER平均将推理上下文大小减少约40%，同时在某些情况下保持甚至提高了预测准确性。

Conclusion: STEER通过结合语义相关性与高效采样，有效解决了RFMs推理成本高且简单裁剪导致信息丢失的问题，实现了效率与精度的平衡。

Abstract: Relational foundation models (RFMs) are pretrained once on a collection of relational databases and prediction tasks, and then applied zero-shot to previously unseen databases and tasks. To make a prediction for a target row, an RFM samples a neighborhood of rows linked to that row through foreign keys and uses this neighborhood as its inference context. Lowering inference cost is an important goal for any foundation model, and for RFMs this cost grows with the size of the context. The simplest ways to shrink the context is to drop some of the sampled rows, but this ignores the semantics of the database schema, so it is as likely to discard informative rows as uninformative ones. We propose STEER, a sampling approach that shrinks the inference context by concentrating it on the tables most relevant to the prediction task at hand. STEER obtains relevance information by prompting a large language model to rank the foreign-key edges of the database schema into relevance tiers for the given task, and then maps each tier to a probability of following that edge during traversal. Because the ranking uses only the schema, it is computed once per task and reused across all subsequent predictions, amortizing its cost. We evaluate STEER on three state-of-the-art RFMs (RT, RT-J, and Griffin) and show that it reduces inference context size by about 40% on average while maintaining, and in some cases improving, prediction accuracy.

</details>


### [456] [Bridging the Omics Divide: A Modular Relational Approach to Multi-Layer Biological Data Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01482)
*Alessandro Balestrucci,Donald Friggieri,Andrea Gariboldi,Panagiotis Alexiou*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 开发了vcf2db，一种基于样本的中心化关系型框架，旨在解决高通量分子数据在检索、整合和扩展性方面的挑战。通过1000 Genomes Project数据进行基准测试，证明其在坐标和注释查询方面性能优异，并成功验证了通过共享样本ID链接转录组等多组学层的模块化扩展能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于文件的基因组工作流程因存储碎片化和非结构化查询方式，阻碍了跨模态分析和可重复性。现有工具缺乏对模块化多组学整合的支持，亟需一种能高效检索、集成并具备可扩展性的系统。

Method: 构建以生物样本为中心的关系型数据库架构，将每种组学模态建模为独立但可链接的组件。使用欧洲人群1000 Genomes Project子集（502个样本，2500万变异）作为数据源，实现概念验证模式和数据摄入管道。与三种现有的VCF专用工具在七项检索任务上进行基准对比，并添加合成转录组层以验证模块扩展性。

Result: 在受控条件下，vcf2db在选择性查询中表现强劲，特别是在坐标过滤和注释驱动查询方面优于其他系统，基因型检索也保持可用性。聚合密集型任务效率较低，指出了优化方向。成功通过共享样本标识符将合成转录组层与基因组表链接，未修改基因组表即实现了多层整合。

Conclusion: vcf2db支持直接基于SQL查询的跨层检索，通过共享样本标识符实现难以通过基于文件的方法实现的集成多组学访问，证明了其作为高效、可扩展的多组学数据管理框架的有效性。

Abstract: Background: Rapid growth of high-throughput molecular data demands systems for efficient retrieval, integration, and scalability across omics layers. Traditional file-based workflows hinder cross-modal analysis and reproducibility because of fragmented storage and ad-hoc querying. Few existing tools for genomic variation data prioritize modular multi-omics integration. We developed vcf2db, a sample-centric relational framework modeling each omics modality as a distinct but linkable component centered on biological samples. This study evaluates whether this design delivers competitive genomic retrieval while enabling extension to additional molecular layers. Results: We implemented a proof-of-concept genomic schema and ingestion pipeline for annotated VCF data using the European subset of the 1000 Genomes Project (502 samples, 25 million variants). We benchmarked it against three established VCF-oriented tools on seven retrieval tasks: coordinate filtering, annotation-driven queries, genotype extraction, and aggregation. Under controlled conditions, vcf2db performed strongly on selective queries, often outperforming other systems for coordinate and annotation filters, and remained usable for genotype retrieval. Aggregation-heavy tasks were less efficient, indicating optimization targets. We also validated modular extensibility by adding a synthetic transcriptomic layer without modifying genomic tables, linking layers via shared sample identifiers. Conclusion: vcf2db supports cross-layer retrieval directly as SQL queries anchored on shared sample identifiers, enabling integrated multi-omics access that is difficult with file-based approaches.

</details>


### [457] [DIADA: Automatic Data Composition in Data Lakes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01646)
*Marc Maynou,Albert Martin,Sergi Nadal,Anna Queralt,Oscar Romero*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: 提出DIADA系统，通过多变量依赖关系自动组织数据湖中的属性，构建与特定任务无关的通用数据基础，以提升下游分析的性能和可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据湖中属性分散且关联需手动判断；仅基于连接性合并缺乏相关性保证；针对单一目标选择特征会丢弃对其他任务有用的属性。需要一种与具体分析任务无关的方法来组织异构数据湖，形成可服务于多种下游分析的通用基础。

Method: 提出DIADA系统，以多变量依赖性作为评估关系有意义性的标准。通过将属性映射到谓词空间并构建包含关系的格结构，假设属性间独立性并识别违反该假设的集合（即存在依赖性的集合）。开发了一种专用且可扩展的算法来高效探索该空间，从而发现传统算法难以识别的依赖关系。

Result: DIADA能够发现传统方法无法识别的大规模依赖关系；应用单一的数据组成流程可惠及多种潜在的下游任务；生成的低噪声、统计相关属性子集提高了检测模式真实性的置信度，防止了大规模环境中的常见建模问题。

Conclusion: 数据组成问题可通过基于多变量依赖性的自动化方法解决，DIADAsystem提供的通用数据组织方式能有效支持多样化下游分析，增强数据分析的准确性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Data lakes contain a plethora of attributes scattered across many tables that, when combined, provide enhanced assets for data analysis. Nonetheless, deciding which attributes belong together in meaningful relations remains a manual, per-task effort. Merging by joinability alone provides no guarantees regarding attribute relevance, while selecting features against a single target discards attributes useful to other tasks. To address this gap, we introduce the data composition problem: organizing a fragmented, heterogeneous lake into meaningful relations, agnostic of any particular analytical task so that the resulting organization can serve as a common foundation for diverse downstream analyses. We propose DIADA, a composition system that employs multivariate dependence as the criterion for assessing the meaningfulness of a relation and approximates it by hypothesizing independence among attributes and identifying those sets that violate this hypothesis. To do so, we map the attributes to a predicate space, forming a lattice under inclusion and mining those predicate sets that exhibit dependence among their constituents. We contribute a dedicated and scalable algorithm to effectively explore this space, outscaling classical algorithms for mining relationships, thus discovering dependencies that would otherwise be impractical to identify. We demonstrate that applying a single data composition process benefits diverse potential downstream tasks. This is the result of providing a subset of low-noise, statistically relevant attributes that increases the confidence that detected patterns are grounded in real relationships, thus preventing common modeling issues in large-scale environments.

</details>


### [458] [Prune First, Decide Fast: Scalable Semantic Query Processing with JEVDB](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02046)
*Zhengle Wang,Hanxu Yan,Fuheng Zhao,Chunwei Liu*

Main category: cs.DB

TL;DR: JEVDB通过结合快速分类模型和生成式LLM，利用语义布隆过滤器优化连接操作，显著降低了语义数据库的延迟与成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语义数据库依赖自回归大语言模型（LLM）处理离散关系决策，导致高延迟和高昂的经济成本。

Method: 提出JEVDB系统，使用快速类型化决策模型处理过滤、连接、分类和排序，仅在不确定时升级至生成式LLM；结合Yannakakis风格半连接缩减与语义布隆过滤器（SBF）减少语义连接计算量。

Result: 在SemBench上实现最低延迟和成本；在Shelob基准测试中保持95.7%-97.5%的平均F1分数；SBF筛选移除87.4%候选对，条件索引评分减少55.2%的推理模型升级。

Conclusion: JEVDB有效解决了传统语义数据库的高延迟和高成本问题，在保证答案质量的同时实现了高效的可扩展性。

Abstract: Semantic database systems extend SQL with foundation-model inference over unstructured data, but current engines rely heavily on autoregressive LLMs for discrete relational decisions, creating high latency and monetary cost. We present JEVDB, a scalable semantic database system that uses fast, typed decision models for semantic filters, joins, classification, and ranking, while selectively escalating uncertain cases to generative LLMs. To reduce semantic-join work, JEVDB combines exact Yannakakis-style semijoin reduction over relational structure with Semantic Bloom Filters (SBFs), which use registered necessary conditions to screen candidates across latent semantic edges.
  We evaluate JEVDB on SemBench and Shelob, a TPC-DS-derived semantic-join workload. On SemBench, JEVDB-Flash achieves the lowest latency on all 21 evaluated queries and the lowest cost on 19, while maintaining competitive answer quality. On Shelob, where joins scale to 540K candidate pairs, JEVDB completes all queries with 95.7%-97.5% mean F1. SBF screening removes 87.4% of candidate pairs before semantic evaluation, and reusable condition-index scoring further reduces reasoning-model escalations by 55.2%. An interactive query simulator, source code, and benchmarks are available at https://jevdb.org.

</details>
